**Job Title:** 
 PRO PM Manager MEA region \- Siemens Grid Software
   

  

**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE or Kuwait City, Kuwait
   

  

**About the role:**
 Siemens Grid Software is driving the digital transformation of power systems across the globe. As Zone Head of Project Management, you will be the regional PM authority — accountable for the governance, performance, and delivery of a complex, multi\-country project portfolio. You lead with discipline, build high\-performing teams, and create predictable outcomes for customers across the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
**Strategic \& Portfolio Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end portfolio governance — performance, financials, quality, and delivery KPIs
* Drive delivery readiness during bid and contract award to protect margin and prevent scope creep
* Act as the regional PM authority, setting the bar for execution standards


**Operational Excellence**
* Ensure consistent application of PM@S processes aligned with Global PMO standards
* Drill into critical or at\-risk projects and lead recovery where needed
* Coordinate closely with operations and support functions to meet delivery commitments


**Customer \& Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as senior escalation point for customers, partners, and external stakeholders
* Build customer confidence through structured engagement and predictable project outcomes


**People \& Resource Leadership**
* Optimize capacity planning — ensure the right PMs and competencies are in place
* Build a high\-performance, accountable project culture across the zone
* Identify capability gaps and actively develop talent


**Financial \& Risk Management**
* Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and portfolio financial performance
* Ensure compliance with legal, EHS, and regulatory requirements
* Proactively identify, escalate, and mitigate project risks


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or comparable technical discipline
* Proven senior leadership experience with P\&L responsibility across large, complex project portfolios
* Deep understanding of power utility automation, digital solutions, and EPC\-based business models
* Track record of leading multidisciplinary, cross\-regional technical teams
* Strong customer\-facing and negotiation skills at executive level
* Professional certifications preferred: PMP, PM@S, Six Sigma / Black Belt
* Fluent in English — Arabic language skills are a significant asset


**What Do We Offer**
* Flexible mobile working — 2 to 3 days per week as a global standard
* A diverse, inclusive culture where you can bring your whole self
* Broad learning \& development opportunities to grow personally and professionally
* The chance to deliver work that shapes industries and contributes to a sustainable future


**What else do you need to know?**
 As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced engineering technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate \- all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant that benefits society and human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference.
   

  

 Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of the Society. Therefore, we value the candidates that reflect the Diversity that we enjoy in our Company. Please find more information at www.siemens.com
   

  

 At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds
   

  

 We are looking forward to receiving your online application.
   

  

 Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

**We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose**
 BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Director, Strategic Initiatives is responsible for leading the identification, development, and execution of high\-impact critical initiatives that drive business growth, operational excellence, and transformation across the region and/or global function.
   

  

 This role works closely with senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans. It ensures alignment across commercial, operational, and functional groups. It delivers measurable outcomes within a sophisticated, matrixed environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Planning \& Execution**
* Translate enterprise and regional strategy into executable initiatives and implementation roadmaps
* Define clear milestones, KPIs, and success measures aligned to business priorities
* Drive alignment between global strategy and regional execution


**Transformation \& Change Leadership**
* Lead cross\-functional transformation initiatives across commercial, operational, and digital domains
* Act as a change agent to drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working
* Ensure sustainability and scalability of implemented initiatives


**Program \& Portfolio Management**
* Manage a portfolio of pivotal initiatives end\-to\-end (from concept to execution)
* Establish governance frameworks, including tracking progress, risks, and dependencies
* Ensure delivery of initiatives on time, within scope, and delivering measurable impact


**Business Analytics \& Performance Insights**
* Lead all aspects of the development and use of analytics, dashboards, and reporting tools
* Provide insights on business performance, trends, and improvement opportunities
* Support data\-driven decision making across leadership teams


**Financial Planning \& Performance Management**
* Support financial planning processes including Annual Budget, Forecasts, and ASR cycles
* Supervise and evaluate financial impact of central initiatives
* Find opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and efficiency improvements


**Cross\-functional Teamwork \& Partner Management**
* Partner with Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, HR, and other functions
* Influence senior partners and align priorities across regions
* Drive execution through teamwork in a matrix environment


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field)
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred


**Experience**
* Meaningful progressive experience in strategy, consulting, commercial operations, or transformation
* Proven experience leading sophisticated, cross\-functional critical initiatives
* Experience working in global, matrixed organizations preferred


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong critical thinking and execution capability
* Sophisticated analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong financial savvy and understanding of business drivers
* Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills
* Proven program and project management expertise
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment


**Leadership Proficiencies (BD\-style)**
* Gets Results: Accountable for delivering measurable business outcomes
* Strategic Attitude: Translates vision into executable strategies
* Cultivates Collaboration: Works effectively across boundaries
* Influences \& Communicates: Engages and aligns partners at all levels
* Manages Complexity: Navigates ambiguity and drives clarity


**Key Performance Indicators.**
* Execution and delivery of pivotal initiatives (timeline, scope, quality)
* Financial impact (revenue growth, cost savings, margin improvement)
* Adoption and sustainability of transformation programs
* Improvement in commercial and operational performance metrics.


**Key Relationships**
* President META and META Leadership Team
* Country General Managers
* Key customers, clinicians, KOLs, and strategic partners
* Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, HR


**Additional Information**
* Role requires travel across META markets.
* Position operates in a highly regulated healthcare environment with significant governance requirements.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face\-to\-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary** 




 The Project Management Director is responsible for managing and delivering transformation projects and other strategic initiatives under Transformation \& PMO. Ensure that projects align with organizational goals, adhere to project management best practices, and drive continuous improvement in business processes. Additionally, project planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and risk management to ensure timely and successful project completion.
 



  





  





**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 



1. **Project Planning \& Execution** 
 : Develop comprehensive project plans, set clear deliverables, and ensure projects are executed within scope, timeline, and budget
2. **Stakeholder Coordination** 
 : Engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment of project objectives, expectations, and key milestones
3. **Transformation Project Management** 
 : Lead transformation initiatives by implementing structured methodologies to optimize efficiency and enhance operational effectiveness
4. **Resource Allocation** 
 : Manage project resources effectively, ensuring optimal utilization of personnel, tools, and financial resources
5. **Risk \& Issue Management** 
 : Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and proactively address challenges to ensure project success
6. **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 
 : Track project progress, generate status reports and provide insights to leadership on project performance metrics
7. **Governance \& Compliance** 
 : Ensure adherence to PMO governance frameworks, organizational policies, and relevant compliance requirements throughout project execution
8. **Change Management** 
 : Support the adoption of new processes and technologies by implementing management strategies that facilitate smooth transitions
9. **Continuous Improvement** 
 : Identify areas for process enhancement, leverage project learnings, and contribute to refining PMO best practices
10. **Budget Oversight** 
 : Monitor project budgets, ensure cost control, and recommend financial adjustments to optimize expenditures while maintaining quality
11. **Quality Assurance** 
 : Implement quality standards in project execution, ensuring deliverables meet the required specifications and stakeholder expectations
12. **Information Security \& Compliance** 
 : Adhere to internal security policies and industry regulations to safeguard project data and maintain confidentiality



  





  





  





**Required Professional Experience** 



* Minimum of 7 years of experience in project management, preferably in transformation projects or large\-scale initiative
* Experience in managing multiple projects within a structured PMO



  





  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field
* PMP, PRINCE2, or an equivalent project management certification is preferred



  





  





**Required Skills and Competencies** 



* Strong leadership and team collaboration skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Effective stakeholder management and negotiation skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Clear and concise communication, both written and verbal



  





  





**Required Technical** 
 S
 


* Skills: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana, or Trello).
* Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid project management methodologies
* Expertise in process improvement frameworks and digital transformation
* Financial acumen to oversee project budgeting and cost control

data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

data.jd_text:
**Head of Transformation (Project Lifecycle Management)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Transformation to lead a large\-scale enterprise transformation programme across a complex project and real estate portfolio. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving end\-to\-end business transformation across project delivery, commercial operations, governance, financial management, handover, and operational readiness.
 



  





 The successful candidate will own the transformation vision, business case, value realisation, and adoption strategy, ensuring measurable business outcomes through the implementation of standardised processes, governance frameworks, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
 



 This role is focused on transforming how projects are delivered and managed across the organisation—not simply implementing systems or managing programme governance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and lead the transformation vision, strategy, and business case across the project lifecycle.
* Drive measurable business outcomes including improved governance, compliance, cost control, schedule performance, transparency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the design and implementation of future\-state operating models and standardised ways of working.
* Champion organisational change and user adoption across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* Partner with executive leadership to secure alignment, influence decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional challenges.
* Develop and manage a multi\-year transformation roadmap, balancing business priorities, value delivery, and organisational readiness.
* Oversee delivery through programme, platform, integration, and change management teams.
* Ensure successful coordination between business and technology functions, including enterprise platforms and integrated systems.
* Build and lead high\-performing transformation, product, and change teams capable of sustaining long\-term organisational capability.
* Manage external partners and vendors to ensure delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, and business outcomes.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 12–18\+ years of experience leading large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Proven track record delivering measurable business value through organisational transformation and change initiatives.
* Experience leading multi\-year, cross\-functional transformation programmes at enterprise scale.
* Strong change management and adoption leadership, with demonstrated success driving behavioural and process change.
* Ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing priorities, risks, and business outcomes.
* Experience in at least one of the following: real estate, construction, infrastructure, or capital project environments
* Project lifecycle management and capital delivery processes
* Enterprise project management or project controls platforms (e.g., Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or similar solutions)
* Understanding of governance, controls, delegation of authority frameworks, audit requirements, and integrated ERP environments.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand new business domains and technologies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree is mandatory.
* Experience within the GCC region, particularly the UAE.
* Exposure to real estate development, infrastructure, or large capital project portfolios.
* Knowledge of Oracle Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or equivalent project lifecycle management platforms.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or Prosci Change Management.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 This opportunity is ideal for a transformation leader who has successfully led enterprise\-wide change programmes and thrives in complex, fast\-paced environments. We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution, can influence senior stakeholders, and has a passion for driving sustainable organisational transformation and value creation.

**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Act as the central operational link and technical attaché to the Project Controls Director, driving portfolio\-wide data consolidation, cross\-functional stakeholder coordination, and executive reporting from the Head Office. This role is responsible for standardizing reporting frameworks across all high\-rise and master development sites, monitoring design and procurement trackers, and developing C\-suite presentations, serving as the strategic right\-hand support for all departmental operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Portfolio Data Consolidation \& Reporting Governance
* Central Database Management: Establish and maintain the department's central project controls database, ensuring seamless data harvesting and consolidation from all project sites.
* Reporting Standardization: Design, implement, and enforce standardized weekly and monthly reporting templates across contractors, consultants, and internal project teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency.
* Periodic Audit \& Review: Conduct rigorous reviews of incoming site reports, cross\-verifying contractor progress claims against actual site conditions and flagging critical path anomalies, schedule risks, and reporting inconsistencies directly to the Project Controls Director.
* Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination (Pre\-Contract Tracks)
* Design \& Procurement Tracking: Establish, manage, and continuously update comprehensive trackers and dashboards for pre\-construction activities, with a strong focus on design development, authority approvals, procurement milestones, and package award schedules.
* Internal Stakeholder Interface: Coordinate directly with Development Managers, Design Directors, and Procurement leads to resolve scheduling conflicts and ensure pre\-contract deliverables align with planned construction commencement dates.
* Master Program Development: Support the Project Controls Director in developing, maintaining, and logic\-linking portfolio\-level master programs that integrate design, permitting, tendering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Executive Analytics \& C\-Suite Presentations
* Dashboard Management: Maintain and oversee the department’s live Power BI and ERP\-based dashboards, transforming complex project, commercial, and schedule data into meaningful performance indicators and executive\-level insights.
* Executive Presentation Development: Consolidate portfolio\-wide progress updates, schedule risks, delay exposures, and cost\-related insights into professional, structured presentations and briefing materials for the CDO, CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team.
* Special Briefings \& Ad\-Hoc Analytics: Act as an operational extension of the Project Controls Director by conducting deep\-dive analyses, forensic schedule reviews, and focused data audits on critical or distressed project packages as required.
* Site\-HO Bridging \& Compliance Enforcement
* Site Coordination: Maintain close engagement with embedded site planning teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure real\-time visibility of progress, risks, and emerging critical path delays.
* Process Enforcement: Audit planning and reporting compliance across all projects, ensuring schedule networks, baseline updates, milestone reporting, and delay notifications adhere strictly to Arada’s Project Controls Manual and governance requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP or PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional) certifications are highly advantageous.


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of progressive project planning and scheduling experience within the UAE real estate, developer, or construction sector.
* A balanced background is essential, including:
+ Minimum 3–4 years of hands\-on site\-based construction planning and execution experience.
+ Minimum 3–4 years within a Head Office PMO, Project Controls, or Developer corporate environment.

* Proven experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced to expert\-level proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and data visualization skills.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation design with the ability to prepare executive\-level reporting materials.
* Strong understanding of project controls methodologies, schedule governance, and portfolio reporting frameworks.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational agility.
* Ability to confidently engage with senior leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Strong analytical mindset with the capability to challenge assumptions, identify reporting inconsistencies, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview/Purpose**
 The Lead – Business Operations, Global Oncology will play a critical role in driving launch excellence and early access strategies across small to mid\-sized markets where Glenmark Oncology does not have dedicated in\-country oncology leadership.
   

  

 This role will act as a strategic and operational partner to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology, ensuring organizational readiness, optimal resource allocation, and execution of commercial infrastructure (including CRM and analytics). The incumbent will also serve as support to the Global Head in governance, decision\-making, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

**Overall Job Responsibilities**
* Launch Excellence \& Early Access Strategy
* Lead the development and execution of launch strategies for oncology assets in small\-to\-mid\-sized markets.
* Design scalable, repeatable “go\-to\-market” models tailored for distributor\-led or hybrid markets.
* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.
* Market Development (Non\-Core / White Space Markets)
* Identify, prioritize, and assess new market opportunities where Glenmark lacks oncology presence.
* Build market entry playbooks (partner vs. direct vs. hybrid models).
* Support distributor selection, onboarding, and performance management.
* Ensure alignment of local execution with global brand strategy.
* Commercial Operations \& Infrastructure
* Lead implementation and optimization of CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce Health Cloud).
* Establish standardized commercial processes, reporting dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making through analytics and insights generation.
* Oversee commercial excellence initiatives including:
* Sales force effectiveness (where applicable)
* Omnichannel engagement frameworks
* Digital enablement tools
* Organizational Readiness \& Capability Building
* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.
* Benchmark best practices from leading oncology players (MNCs).
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for Glenmark.
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to distributor\-led markets and early access programs.
* Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.
* Time\-to\-market reduction in non\-core geographies.
* CRM implementation effectiveness and adoption rates.
* Achievement of early access program targets.
* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.


**Key Relationships/Stakeholders**
**External**
* Oncology KOLs and treatment centers
* Oncology societies and networks
* Strategic partners and service providers


**Internal (other Than Direct Reports)**
* Regional/Country Commercial Leadership Teams
* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

data.jd_text:
**Role Description:** 




 This is a senior, group\-level role based in Dubai, reporting directly to the CEO. The Head of Operations \- Group provides operational leadership, governance and standardisation across Byrne's regional operations in the GCC.
 



 You'll drive fleet availability and utilisation, workshop and maintenance performance, logistics effectiveness, CAPEX planning and HSE compliance balancing local operational agility with Group\-wide consistency. Working closely with General Managers, Operations Managers, the Group Asset Manager, Procurement, HSE and Finance, you'll establish and monitor Group\-wide operational KPIs, scale operations efficiently and maximise fleet ROI across all territories.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical or related), or an equivalent technical foundation gained through experience
* 10\+ years in equipment rental, power generation, industrial services, logistics or construction equipment, including several years in a senior multi\-site or regional operations leadership role
* Multi\-country GCC experience (strongly preferred)
* Proven leadership of multi\-disciplinary, multi\-site teams (ideally across multiple countries) spanning operations, fleet, workshop/service, yard, transport and logistics
* Demonstrable track record of scaling operations while maintaining control, reliability and service standards
* Strong workshop, fleet, transport and operational cost\-control background
* Hands\-on experience with ERP / rental systems and asset utilisation reporting
* Strategic mindset with the ability to standardise and scale operations across regions



  





**Ideal Background:** 




 You're a hands\-on yet strategic operations leader with a solid engineering or technical foundation, who understands equipment and fleet inside out. You've progressed through operational roles in equipment rental, power or industrial services, built systems that let a business grow without losing control, and led teams across multiple disciplines and ideally multiple countries. You combine commercial awareness with operational rigour, lead from the front on safety and standards, and know how to turn performance data into action.
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 Byrne Equipment Rental LLC, part of the Byrne Group, has been a leader in the Middle East’s equipment rental industry for over three decades. Headquartered in Dubai, the company operates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain, boasting a fleet of 16,000\+ assets including modular buildings, power solutions, climate control, and hybrid solar systems. Recognized as one of the Top 100 Global Equipment Rental Companies (IRN100\), Byrne is dedicated to delivering reliable, innovative, and sustainable turnkey rental and infrastructure solutions. The company is committed to regional growth, digital transformation, and green energy investments.

 Art Dubai Group is a public\-private partnership with Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) founded in 2007, and has grown to become the most experienced cultural programming company in the Gulf.  We are seeking a
 **Head of Operations** 
 to lead Art Dubai Group's cross\-company functions and drive operational excellence across the organization, with end\-to\-end accountability for operational performance and team management. data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**About PFM**
 Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast\-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff. Whether you're a trader, technologist, marketer, or operator \- your work here shapes how thousands of users find and trust prop firms.
   

  

**About The Department**
 UAE Operations \& Regulatory Affairs sits at the intersection of Finance, Legal, and Operations. It owns the integrity of PFM's UAE\-based entity (Prop Firm Match Global FZCO) — governance, free\-zone compliance, banking, tax, audit, visa sponsorship, and regulator\-facing relationships. Our current priority is professionalising the local operating layer so the business can scale internationally without regulatory or operational drag.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Own everything PFM does in the UAE — entity governance, regulatory standing, banking and tax compliance, audit readiness, free\-zone licensing, visa sponsorship, and relationships with local authorities and service providers. Be the senior PFM presence on the ground in the UAE and the trusted commercial\-regulatory bridge between leadership and the UAE ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Performance objectives**
**Objective 1 \- Own UAE entity governance and free\-zone compliance**
 Outcome: Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is fully compliant, in good standing, and audit\-ready at all times.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Maintain free\-zone licence, share capital, and corporate documentation up to date
* Ensure timely renewals, statutory filings, and entity\-level reporting
* Coordinate with the free\-zone authority on all governance matters
* Run quarterly governance reviews with the CFO


**Objective 2 \- Lead regulatory affairs and authority relationships**
 Outcome: PFM operates with regulatory clarity in the UAE and can navigate questions from authorities quickly and credibly.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Own the regulatory map for PFM's activities in the UAE (free\-zone, federal, financial\-services adjacencies)
* Build and maintain relationships with regulators, free\-zone authorities, banks, and key service providers
* Track regulatory changes affecting PFM and translate them into business impact and action items
* Lead any direct regulator engagement or audit on PFM's behalf, in coordination with legal counsel
* Partner with internal and external legal counsel on the UAE legal landscape — contracts, employment law, FZCO governance, commercial agreements, and dispute resolution


**Objective 3 \- Manage UAE operations: banking, tax, audit, and admin**
 Outcome: All UAE\-side operational rails (banking, corporate tax, VAT, audit, visas, office, vendors) run smoothly with no surprises.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Manage banking relationships and resolve account\-, transaction\-, or compliance\-related issues
* Oversee UAE corporate tax (9%) and VAT registration, filings, and compliance with the Federal Tax Authority
* Lead the annual statutory audit cycle in coordination with the Finance function
* Sponsor visas for UAE\-based hires and manage related immigration, residency, and renewal workflows
* Own the UAE office presence (if applicable), vendor contracts, insurance, and local administration


**Objective 4 \- Partner with leadership on UAE strategic initiatives**
 Outcome: Leadership has a trusted UAE partner who can scope, scale, and de\-risk any new initiative anchored in the region.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Advise leadership on the regulatory and operational implications of new products, partnerships, or markets
* Lead UAE\-specific initiatives such as banking expansion, new entity structures, or regulatory licensing
* Represent PFM in select UAE industry forums and at high\-trust meetings with partners or authorities
* Surface risks and opportunities to the CFO and CEO with clear written analysis


**What We Look For**
**Must have**
* 7\+ years of operations, regulatory, or compliance leadership experience in the UAE
* Hands\-on familiarity with one or more UAE free zones (e.g., DMCC, IFZA, DIFC, ADGM, JAFZA)
* Strong working knowledge of UAE corporate tax, VAT, and Federal Tax Authority requirements
* Experience managing banking relationships and resolving compliance / KYC matters with UAE banks
* Track record of running statutory audits and filings end\-to\-end
* Demonstrated experience working with internal or external legal counsel on UAE\-specific matters — contracts, employment law, free\-zone governance, or commercial agreements
* Excellent English; comfortable operating in a remote\-first, async\-first environment


**Nice to have**
* Background in fintech, financial services, brokerage, or trading\-adjacent industries
* DIFC or ADGM\-specific licensing experience
* Working Arabic — useful for direct regulator and bank conversations
* Existing relationships with UAE regulators, free\-zone authorities, or top legal / audit firms
* Experience scaling a UAE entity through tax or regulatory transitions (e.g., corporate tax rollout)


**Compensation**
 $6,000\-$10,000 / month gross
   

  

**Reporting cadence**
 Reports to: Albert B., CFO.
   

  

 Direct reports: None at hire. May grow to include UAE\-based operational staff over time.
   

  

 Key cross\-functional partners: Finance, Leadership (Martin J., John R., Ashlee C.), HR, Legal counsel, external auditors and bankers.
   

  

 Upward reporting cadence: Weekly 1:1 with CFO; monthly written summary covering compliance, regulator interactions, and operational risks; quarterly strategic review with leadership.
   

  

**Location \& work setup**
* Location: UAE\-based (Dubai preferred), with the ability to be physically present at relevant authorities, banks, and the free\-zone office when needed
* Working hours: Flexible, with reasonable overlap with CET hours (4\+ hours of overlap)
* Employment type: Full\-time


**Benefits**
**Hiring stages**
 We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:
   

  

* Application screening We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status
* Video intro \+ role fit questionnaire A short async step \- no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire. This helps us understand who you are, your relevant background, and how your experience aligns with the role without either side committing to a live call upfront
* Discovery HR Interview A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match. We'll walk you through how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like in practice, and what success in this role looks like. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and share your goals
* Real\-world task (paid) A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM UAE operations or regulatory challenge. We compensate for your time because we believe that's the right way to do it. This stage is designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further
* Professional interview You will meet our CFO, Albert B., to focus on your UAE operations and regulatory expertise — entity governance, banking, tax, free\-zone matters, and how you approach complex regulatory situations. This is the decisive conversation on domain skills and role\-specific experience
* Peer \& values conversation A cross\-team interview evaluated against PFM's structured values scorecard. You'll meet a peer (Rana Eh.) and a bar raiser (Konstantinos K., Head of Data \& Analytics) from outside the immediate team
* Leadership interview (optional) A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM


 If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
   

  

**Before applying take into account that:**
 ▸ If you don't meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires \- we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 ▸ Even if it's not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.
   

  

**Not the right fit for this role?**
 If this role isn't the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area \- we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

data.jd_text:
The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

* Collaborates with purchasing partners, operations and legal representatives to develop vendor agreements as needed.

data.jd_text:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.

 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous l'autorité conjointe du Conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) et du Conseil d’administration (CA) de l'Alliance française de Dubaï, vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement. Vous pilotez, organisez, gérez et représentez l’Alliance française de Dubaï (AFD) et l’action culturelle française à Dubaï et dans les Emirats du Nord. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la mondialisation , le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'AFD dispose d'une médiathèque, une salle de cinéma/spectacle, une salle d’expositions, salles de classe. Dans ce cadre, vous devrez assurer les: \-élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l’établissement sur les plans culturel et pédagogique (programmation commune, dates d’examens, etc.). Poursuite de la diversification de l’offre de cours de langue impulsée depuis plusieurs années ; \- organisation d’événements annuels en collaboration avec les partenaires locaux ou sur fonds propres ; \- gestion des réseaux sociaux, \- développement de Culturethèque et du fonds de la médiathèque. Organisation d'événements internes. \- recherche de partenariats avec les entreprises françaises (BNP, Soc. Générale…) ou locales (émigration, douanes, municipalité, universités…) pour le développement des diplômes TCF (test de connaissance du français)/ TEF (test d'évaluation de français) et e.TEF/Delf Adulte, DELF junior et DELF Prim ; \- élaboration du budget prévisionnel de l'établissement, en accord avec le CA, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi, le budget concernant les pôles pédagogique, culturel et communication, administratif et médiathèque. \-établissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays comme avec les partenaires pédagogiques (directeurs d’établissements, départements universitaires notamment); \-Préparation et remise de rapports réguliers d’activité et compte\-rendu des réalisations et du contexte au C.A. lors des réunions trimestrielles, au conseiller culturel, à l'ambassadeur lors des réunions sur l’Ambassade et au Département (Direction générale de la Mondialisation \-DGM\-) lors de l’envoi de rapports.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Niveau Bac \+5 ou équivalent. Expérience avérée de direction d’un établissement public ou privé à l’étranger ou en France, dans des institutions culturelles ou des collectivités territoriales. La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.


**What You Will Need For This Position**
* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.


**Key Metrics**
* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.
