 When focused on our commercial business:

 Amazon works hard to delight customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, \& fluid.  If so, the Amazon Now team is for you. We partner directly with product and software teams to develop the future of quick commerce.
   

  

 The Tech SME team acts as a catalyst for change by driving innovation at the operator level, prioritizing technology initiatives and supporting engineering design innovations. Tech SMEs strive to be experts in Amazon’s operation systems. They are accountable to delivering world class solutions through optimizing and reinventing the existing technology.
   

  

 The Tech SME is a functional expert on the software tools in given process areas and their application in the network. A successful manager in this organization has strong program management experience to define the process the team uses to deliver best in class tech to the field. This person looks for ways to automate human decision making by influencing Technology to build and update tools that reduce process complexity to deliver robust processes.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) supports, coordinates and facilitates implementation of new \& improved processes within the quick commerce operations. The SME works closely with the store operations, last mile delivery teams, and local \& global product teams.  Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technology programs and initiatives for darkstore operations, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems
* Drive Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations programs at the darkstore level, optimizing inbound, warehouse, and last\-mile delivery processes

* Support new store launches, including but not limited to configurations, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), etc., coordinating with multiple global product \& tech teams and work with external stakeholders to continuously reduce the time to launch a store

* Maintain strong relationship with the IN, NA, MENA, ROW tech teams working for QC business

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

* Bridges and civil engineering works

You will serve as the strategic voice for delivery partners, ensuring their needs are represented in business decisions while balancing operational excellence and partner satisfaction

* Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for delivery partner experience across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey, while maintaining focused implementation in Saudi Arabian operations.

* Draft comprehensive strategy documents and present recommendations to senior leadership, driving alignment and securing resources for key initiatives.
* Establish and manage partnerships with external entities to create campaigns and benefits for Delivery Associates and DSPs, including organizing annual partner meetings and launching ignite events throughout the region.
* Lead country expansion efforts and new program launches within AMET, ensuring consistent implementation of best practices while adapting to local market needs.

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 



* A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**
* Interested applicants should fill out the form.
* AUS alumni are encouraged to apply. Applicants who do not meet specified requirements will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
* AUS is an equal opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to race, color, age, gender, religion, national origin, disability or marital status. Opportunities for employment are based solely upon one’s qualifications.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.
   

  

 This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third\-party integration boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross\-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
* Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third\-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
* Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade\-offs, and cross\-team dependencies
* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
* Lead incident coordination, post\-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
* Own go\-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross\-functional readiness sign\-offs
* Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
* Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
* Contribute to process improvement within the programme scope — identifying friction points and proposing better ways of working
* Support and contribute to tools and dashboards that surface delivery health, pace, and quality for the Rides vertical
* Embed AI tooling into core programme workflows — synthesizing meeting intelligence, surfacing dependency risks, and maintaining high\-quality stakeholder comms at pace — and actively raise the team's capability to do the same


**What You'll Need**
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager in a fast\-paced engineering organisation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and architectural trade\-offs
* Background in fundamental engineering concepts including SSDLC, testing methodologies, API monitoring metrics, and SLAs
* Proficiency with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent)
* Experience managing programmes with significant third\-party integration dependencies
* Familiarity with programme management and analytics tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence, dashboarding tools)
* Operationally fluent with AI tools: for programme synthesis, risk stress\-testing, and communication
* Deep familiarity with the delivery complexity of programmes with significant external API and third\-party integration dependencies — including SLA implications, incident ownership boundaries, and rollback constraints across organisational lines
* Strong communication skills — able to distil complex information clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple teams and manage cross\-organisational stakeholders
* Proven ability to operate with confidence in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with frequent priority shifts
* Passionate problem solver who adapts their approach to evolving requirements and organisational contexts


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

Job Title: AI Character Program Manager (1 Position)
   

  

 About the Job
   

  

 We are seeking a strategic, organized, and innovative AI Character Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of programs focused on AI\-powered characters, digital humans, virtual agents, and interactive personas. The successful candidate will oversee character development initiatives from concept through deployment, ensuring alignment between creative vision, technical implementation, user experience, and business objectives. This is a hands\-on role working closely with AI engineers, character designers, writers, performers, product managers, researchers, and external partners to deliver engaging and scalable AI character experiences across multiple platforms.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the planning and execution of AI character development programs across products, platforms, and initiatives.
   

  

 Define program goals, roadmaps, milestones, and success metrics for digital characters and AI\-driven experiences.
   

  

 Coordinate cross\-functional teams including AI engineers, conversation designers, storytellers, animators, performers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders.
   

  

 Manage the lifecycle of AI characters from ideation and design through deployment, optimization, and long\-term maintenance.
   

  

 Develop project schedules, resource plans, risk assessments, and operational processes to ensure successful program delivery.
   

  

 Oversee character documentation, personality frameworks, behavioral guidelines, and experience standards.
   

  

 Monitor program performance and user engagement metrics to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
   

  

 Facilitate communication among internal teams, external partners, vendors, and stakeholders.
   

  

 Research emerging technologies, tools, and industry trends related to AI characters, digital humans, conversational AI, and interactive experiences.
   

  

 Support strategic planning, presentations, workshops, demonstrations, and business development initiatives related to AI character programs.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 Minimum BA/MA in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Human\-Computer Interaction, Product Management, Digital Media, Psychology, Communications, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
   

  

 At least 3–5 years of experience in program management, product management, AI initiatives, digital media, gaming, interactive experiences, or related industries.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI\-powered products, digital characters, conversational systems, and user engagement principles.
   

  

 Experience working with cross\-functional teams in creative, technical, and product\-focused environments.
   

  

 Knowledge of large language models, conversational AI platforms, digital humans, virtual assistants, or related technologies.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
   

  

 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
   

  

 Experience using project management tools and methodologies to deliver successful programs.
   

  

 Portfolio or track record demonstrating leadership of relevant projects, programs, or product initiatives.
   

  

 Fluency in English; additional languages are considered an asset.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 The opportunity to lead innovative AI character initiatives at the forefront of artificial intelligence and digital interaction.
   

  

 A collaborative team of AI specialists, designers, developers, storytellers, researchers, and creative professionals.
   

  

 Competitive compensation and access to advanced technologies, research resources, and development tools.
   

  

 Opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge projects involving digital humans, conversational AI, virtual characters, and immersive experiences.
   

  

 Professional development, industry visibility, and opportunities to help shape emerging standards in AI character design and deployment.
   

  

 A flexible, dynamic, and innovation\-driven working environment that encourages creativity and experimentation.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Please submit the following to farhang@parsikia.ir with the subject line “AI Character Program Manager”:
   

  

 1\. CV (max 2 pages)
   

  

 2\. Cover Letter (1 page) describing your relevant experience and interest in managing AI character and digital human programs
   

  

 3\. Portfolio, project summaries, case studies, or links to 3 relevant projects (PDF or URL)
   

  

 4\. Two references (name, role, contact information)
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and asked to present a brief AI character program strategy, roadmap, or case study demonstrating their approach to managing complex character\-driven initiatives. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and encourage professionals from AI, product management, gaming, UX, digital media, storytelling, and interactive technology disciplines to apply.

**Job Description**
 We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
   

  

 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
   

  

 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
   

  

 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
   

  

 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
   

  

**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification**
* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.


**Education, Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.


**Other**

**Description**
 Would you like to be part of a team focused on driving innovation in the transportation industry while working to empower entrepreneurs and contribute to Amazon’s sustainability goals?
   

  

 Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Delivery Partner Managers assists and guides our Amazon DSPs (Delivery Service Partner) business owners as they build and grow successful middle\-mile businesses during a transformational time.
   

  

 Delivery Partner Manager manage the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Delivery Partner Manager, work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level, influence their business planning and strategy, and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are set up for success.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* As a Delivery Partner Manager, you will partner with 25\-30 DSP owners across the Emirates (UAE) including entrepreneurs with no background in the logistics industry, or seasoned logistics carrier (Depending on business program)
* Work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics.
* Collaborate with an integrated internal team of Program Managers and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements.
* Support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level.
* As Lead, Delivery Partner Manager will do this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
* They will collaborate frequently with a wide array of integrated internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations (PAR), Value Added Service (VAS), Legal, fleet and network health to name a few. The Delivery Partner Managers support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. They facilitate and execute Monitoring and Enforcement Policies (MEP) and build two\-way feedback channels with OTR teams, DSPs and WW/EU Product and strategy.
* The Delivery Partner Manager will be required to work flexibly and will be required to travel between multiple sites to engage with business owners weekly to carry out their role effectively.


 A day in the life
   

  

 The role is field based and requires a significant level of travel as well as requiring flexibility to work a variety of hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Safety: Partnering with OTR Safety and OTR Regional Managers to ensure business safety compliance.
* Performance: Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp\-up operations and prepare for peak period.
* Performance: Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch (this will be on the basis of a net new launch only)
* Performance: Coach and ensure effective upskilling and utilisation of AMZL tools.
* Performance: Deep dive to identify customer metric improvement opportunities.
* Performance: Champion the consistent application of Last Mile processes within Delivery Stations – challenge UTR processes that impact OTR.
* Performance: Coaching business owners to run compliant, safe and high performing companies (SLS metric deep dive)
* Experience: Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
* Experience: Developing the relationship between Amazon and our DSP partners (DSP sentiment improvements)
* Experience: Communication alignment to DSP business owners following close collaboration with OTR partners.
* Be the voice of the DSP within and represent them within the AMZL business.
* Experience: Improve driver standards to protect brand image.
* Capacity Management: Work with the DSP’s to deliver effective ramp plans and pipeline goals ensuring driver supply is achieved to meet peak volume demands.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of client or vendor facing roles with a focus in relationship management and negotiation skills experience
* Verbal, written, and presentation skills, particularly in delivering constructive feedback and working through complex issues.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.**
**Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.**
**Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.**
****ABOUT TEMENOS****
 Temenos is the world’s leading platform for composable banking, serving clients in 150 countries by helping them build new banking services and state\-of\-the\-art customer experiences.
   

  

 Top performing banks using Temenos software achieve cost\-income ratios almost half the industry average and returns on equity 2X the industry average. Their IT spend on growth and innovation is also 2X the industry average.
   

  

 At Temenos, we have an open\-minded and inclusive culture, where everyone has the power to create their own destiny and make a positive contribution to the world of banking and society.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 The Regional Commercial Director is a senior leadership position reporting directly to the Regional Managing Director. The role focuses on driving commercial performance across the region.
   

  

 As a leader and trusted adviser to the business, you will provide senior sponsorship for strategic deals and lead initiatives that impact key top line metrics, including recurring revenue (ARR), cash collection/DSOs, and gross margin.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role that has tangible impact on regional performance and success – it is both a strategic and hands\-on role, requiring strong leadership, collaboration, and commercial acumen.
   

  

 Success in the role will depend heavily on strong drive and high energy with an ability to lead by example. Equally the ability to work well as part of a team is essential, with strong cross\-functional collaboration, working with Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Support and Partners.
   

  

**Key highlights**
* Senior leadership role shaping commercial strategy and execution across the region
* Direct impact on recurring revenue, pipeline quality, and SaaS deal acceleration
* Instrumental in identifying and spearheading new initiatives
* Empowered to represent the Regional Managing Director internally and externally
* Unique opportunity for a driven, self\-starter with strong energy and a passion for leading, energising and collaborating across commercial teams


**RESPONSIBILITES**
**Strategic Leadership \& Representation**
* Partner with the Regional Managing Director to drive performance across ARR, cash collection, and gross margin

**Sales Acceleration \& Support**
* Bring senior sponsorship and commercial expertise to key SaaS and maintenance deals to accelerate closure.
* Guide sales teams on deal strategy, risk management, and value\-based selling.
* Drive adoption of best\-practice sales methodologies across the region.


**Partnerships \& Collaboration**
* Work closely with marketing, delivery, support, and partners to scale regional initiatives.
* Launch and manage special projects to unlock new commercial opportunities.


****WHAT YOU BRING****
**Proven Leadership**
* 10\+ years of senior commercial leadership experience within enterprise software, fintech, or banking technology
* A strong track record of driving revenue, pipeline growth, and profitability


**Recurring Revenue Expertise**
* Experience growing maintenance and SaaS revenue streams, with a focus on optimising cash collection and margin performance


**Commercial Acumen for SaaS**
* Deep understanding of SaaS deal structures, risk governance, and value\-based selling to support complex, high\-value deals


**Cross\-Functional Influence**
* Ability to lead and align diverse teams across sales, marketing, finance, operations, and partners
* Skilled in forging partnerships and scaling initiatives through external alliances


**Strategic Thinking \& Execution**
* Adept at identifying whitespace opportunities, shaping go\-to\-market strategies, and converting insights into action


**Stakeholder Management**
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leadership, clients, and partners


**Data\-Driven Mindset**
* Comfortable with pipeline, forecasting, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, CPQ) and using analytics to inform decisions


**Energy \& Drive**
* A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, bringing urgency, focus, and senior sponsorship to key initiatives


**WHY JOIN US**
* Play a pivotal role in shaping the commercial success of a global leader in banking technology

**Description**
**JOB PURPOSE**
 Leads GTB technology delivery \& support GTB Tech Lead in the successful implementation of the integrations between GTB Applications, covering cash management, Trade applications, supply chain finance, collections and core banking system (Oracle FLEXCUBE) across Mashreq geographies by acting as the primary interface between the Technology and the assigned business group and the project implementation team.
   

  

**GTB Technology Delivery Ownership**
* Own end to end technology delivery for GTB applications (Payments, Cash Management, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, Collections) as part of the Core Banking (Flexcube) transformation and associated programs.
* Act as the single accountable owner for GTB technology delivery outcomes across geographies, products, and integration landscapes.
* Ensure alignment of GTB delivery roadmap with overall Core Banking program milestones and strategic priorities.


**Portfolio \& Program Delivery Management**
* Govern and oversee, ensuring delivery commitments across multiple streams are met within approved scope, cost, timeline, and quality parameters.
* Review, challenge, and approve delivery plans prepared by Technology Delivery Managers reporting into the role.
* Proactively manage cross domain dependencies, sequencing conflicts, and resource constraints across GTB platforms and core banking integration tracks.
* Maintain delivery transparency through consolidated reporting on status, risks, issues, and mitigation plans to senior technology and program leadership.


**People \& Delivery Leadership**
* Provide directions, and coaching to Technology Delivery Managers.
* Set clear delivery expectations, monitor performance, and drive accountability across reporting teams.
* Ensure optimal capacity planning and skill alignment across GTB technology delivery to meet program and BAU demands.
* Build a strong delivery culture focused on execution discipline, quality, and ownership.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure all GTB technology deliveries comply with enterprise architecture, ISG, security, audit, regulatory, and change governance standards.
* Act as the escalation point for delivery risks, major issues, and program deviations, providing clear recommendations for resolution.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation to minimize business disruption during large scale transformations and releases.


**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**
* Serve as the senior technology interface for GTB Business, Operations, Core Banking program leadership, and external partners.
* Ensure stakeholder expectations are aligned with realistic delivery capacity and agreed operating models.
* Provide oversight of vendor delivery performance, commercial adherence, and contractual commitments across GTB technology engagements.
* Support senior management decision making through impact based recommendations related to delivery trade offs involving scope, timelines, cost, and risk.


**Quality, Stability \& Transformation Outcomes**
* Ensure delivery of stable, scalable, and supportable solutions across GTB platforms in alignment with target architecture and standardized product models.
* Drive reduction in unnecessary customizations and promote reuse and standardization across geographies.
* Ensure readiness for cutover, stabilization, and transition to BAU without disruption post go live risk.


**OPERATING ENVIRONMENT, FRAMEWORK AND BOUNDARIES, WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**
 The GTB Technology Delivery Manager operates within a highly regulated, large scale banking technology environment, leading GTB technology delivery as part of the Core Banking (Oracle FLEXCUBE) transformation and associated strategic programs across Mashreq geographies.
   

  

**Operating Environment \& Framework**
* Operates within enterprise wide technology governance, SDLC, change management, release, and deployment frameworks, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, audit, security, and architectural standards.
* Leads delivery in a complex, multi product, multi vendor environment, covering GTB platforms across Payments, Cash Management, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, and Collections.
* Functions at a portfolio and program level, overseeing multiple delivery streams and managing inter dependencies between GTB systems, core banking, channels, and surrounding applications.
* Ensures execution discipline across delivery teams while balancing program timelines, resource capacity, risk, and business priorities.


 Working Relationships
   

  

* Acts as the senior technology delivery interface for GTB Tech, Business, Operations, Core Banking program leadership, and enterprise Technology stakeholders.
* Provides direction and governance to Technology Delivery Managers and GTB delivery leads reporting into the role, ensuring consistent delivery standards and execution quality.
* Partners with senior business and operations stakeholders to align GTB technology delivery with business objectives and operating model expectations.
* Engages with vendor leadership and system integrators to govern delivery performance, manage dependencies, and ensure contractual and quality commitments are met.
* Represents GTB Technology in program working groups, governance forums, and senior management reviews, providing consolidated delivery status, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Boundaries
* Accountable for end to end GTB technology delivery through implementation and stabilization for assigned programs and initiatives.
* Has oversight responsibility for delivery execution across GTB domains; day to day implementation management is executed by reporting Technology Delivery Managers.
* Ownership of ongoing BAU operations and post stabilization support resides with designated Run / Support teams, as defined in the operating model.


**PROBLEM SOLVING**
* Understand industry standard integration solutions and implement standards across.
* Break down complex issues to identify key information and options.
* Audit, security, and regulatory compliance knowledge.
* Information security operations and incident management.
* People management, interpersonal issues, and staff motivation.


**DECISION MAKING AUTHORITY \& RESPONSIBILITY**
* Responsible for addressing complex challenges related to processes, system configurations, and compliance requirements. This includes resolving discrepancies during data migration, ensuring accurate mapping of data, and troubleshooting integration issues between Oracle FLEXCUBE and other systems. The role requires innovative thinking to optimize system functionalities. Additionally, the incumbent must anticipate potential risks, devise mitigation strategies, and provide timely solutions to minimize disruptions during the implementation process.


**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Postgraduate /Engineer


**Experience**
* 15 to 20 years of experience in Banking Technology, with at least 5 years in system implementation/integration support.
* Demonstrated experience in implementing core banking systems, particularly Oracle Flexcube covering applications like FCUBS, OBTF, OBTFPM, OBLM, OBVAM, OBP, OBDX. Knowledge of Collections \& SCF applications will be a plus.
* Experience in requirements management, Gap analysis and integration solutioning.


**Technical Skills**
* Preferred to have experience in Oracle FLEXCUBE integrations/configurations of products and processes.
* Proven track record of successful system integrations and data migrations


**Behavioural Skills.**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Experience in managing /supporting core banking transformation projects
* Experience in integration and implementing and supporting core banking systems

**What you'll do:** 




 As Regional Finance Director, you will be entrusted with overseeing all aspects of financial management across a diverse regional portfolio. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will involve setting strategic direction for the finance unit, guiding teams through complex challenges, and ensuring high standards of accuracy in reporting. You will work collaboratively with senior leaders to deliver business plans while maintaining rigorous controls that safeguard assets. By establishing clear KPIs and analytics frameworks, you will monitor progress against objectives and provide actionable insights. Your expertise will be crucial in managing statutory audits, preparing detailed accounts for internal and external stakeholders, and supporting company\-wide initiatives such as bid document preparation or project risk reviews. You will also play an integral role in sustainability efforts by sharing responsibility for carbon emissions reduction during project delivery. Success in this role requires you to foster a high\-performing team culture that exceeds expectations while promoting health, safety, wellbeing, and inclusivity throughout the organisation.
 






* Lead the implementation of the regional finance strategy for a designated portfolio, ensuring strategic plans are executed effectively and operational delivery aligns with organisational priorities.
* Maintain an effective financial control environment that mitigates risks of fraud or error, protecting cash, systems, investments, and other assets across the regional portfolio.
* Establish analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for monitoring the execution of the regional finance strategy, providing clear insights into progress and outcomes.
* Act as a finance business partner to the Managing Director for the region, supporting the execution of business plans and driving commercial success.
* Collaborate with the Chief Finance Officer as part of the finance leadership team, offering expertise and counsel on all strategic finance matters within the designated portfolio.
* Oversee comprehensive financial reporting adhering to international accounting standards (IFRS), managing statutory audits and ensuring accurate accounts across subsidiaries.
* Manage monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc management accounts and reporting requirements to meet statutory, fiduciary, country\-specific obligations.
* Review unallocated staff across the regional portfolio, proactively identifying risks or opportunities that may impact sector financial performance.
* Provide monthly reviews of pipeline prospects with senior business stakeholders, ensuring leads and target gaps are accurately reported for executive summaries.
* Issue regular debtors reports and accrued income reports, taking timely action on invoicing and collections while maintaining compliance with third\-party reporting obligations.







**What you bring:** 




 Your proven experience as Regional Finance Director will demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of financial leadership within complex environments. You bring advanced skills in managing multi\-country portfolios using international accounting standards alongside deep expertise in audit processes. Your full accountancy qualifications underpin your ability to deliver accurate reporting while maintaining rigorous controls. You excel at communicating effectively across all levels\-engaging C\-Suite executives as well as nurturing professional networks externally. Your capacity for analytical thinking enables you to identify risks proactively while leveraging opportunities for improvement. As an inspiring leader who builds cohesive teams focused on shared goals, you are adept at guiding both direct and indirect reports towards exceeding performance targets. Your digital literacy ensures seamless integration of technology into daily operations while your commitment to continuous learning supports ongoing professional development. With significant experience in consultancy or related sectors, you understand industry best practices intimately\-making you an invaluable asset capable of driving transformational change.
 






* Comprehensive expertise in financial leadership within industry settings, demonstrated by a track record of achievement leading large or complex finance units or sub\-functions.
* Advanced knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS) with proven experience managing statutory audits and preparing accurate financial reports for multi\-country portfolios.
* Highly developed analytical skills combined with advanced budgetary expertise to oversee complex financial planning processes.
* Expertise in audit and risk management practices that ensure robust controls are maintained across all areas of responsibility.
* Full accountancy qualification such as ACA (Associate Chartered Accountant), ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants), CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants), or equivalent certification.
* Significant relevant experience in finance leadership roles at regional or multi\-country level within consultancy or similar industries.
* Advanced communication skills enabling effective engagement at C\-Suite level as well as building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners including auditors, bankers, insurance brokers, tax advisors, joint venture partners.
* Proven ability to manage direct reports (1\-4\) as well as indirect reports (over 8\), fostering collaborative teamwork that delivers high performance against KPIs \& OKDs.
* Digitally savvy with technical literacy including working proficiency in Oracle systems for efficient data analysis \& reporting.
* Strategic thinking capabilities paired with inspiring leadership qualities that build effective finance teams focused on delivering organisational objectives.







**What's next:** 




 If you are ready to take your career to new heights by joining a collaborative team dedicated to excellence in regional finance leadership, apply now!
 







 Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

**Job Dimensions**

 Strategy \& Operations

data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




 Founded in 2001, Golden Square Engineering Consultants (GS) is a multi\-disciplinary planning and design firm specializing in sustainable, energy\-efficient, and innovative architectural and engineering solutions. With offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah, Baghdad, and Canada, GS delivers high\-quality, cost\-effective results for industrial, residential, commercial, and institutional facilities across the UAE and the MENA region. Partnering with clients in both public and private sectors, the company is known for its expertise in design\-build, peer review, and third\-party consultancy projects. GS is proud to have contributed to numerous landmark projects, maintaining a strong focus on quality, timely delivery, and fostering trusted relationships with international partners.
 



  





**Technical Director – Architectural \& Engineering Consultancy** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Managing Director / Executive Director
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Technical Director is the highest technical authority within the organization, responsible for leading multidisciplinary design and construction supervision functions across a diverse portfolio of projects. This role ensures technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and alignment between design intent and project execution throughout the full project lifecycle.
 



 Combining strategic leadership, client engagement, and financial oversight, the Technical Director drives performance, innovation, and quality across architectural and engineering teams while supporting business growth and operational efficiency.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Technical Leadership** 




 Act as the organization’s principal technical authority across all disciplines (architecture, structural, MEP, quantity survey).
 



 Establish and enforce design standards, technical policies, and quality assurance frameworks.
 



 Ensure all designs comply with local authority regulations, codes, and international best practices.
 



 Provide expert technical input during concept, schematic, detailed design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Review and approve major technical deliverables and engineering solutions.
 



**Project Oversight \& Delivery** 




 Oversee the full project lifecycle from concept design through construction supervision and handover.
 



 Ensure alignment between design intent and on\-site execution.
 



 Lead multidisciplinary coordination to deliver integrated, efficient, and buildable solutions.
 



 Monitor project performance related to quality, timelines, and budgets.
 



 Identify and mitigate technical risks and implement corrective actions.
 



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 Act as a senior technical advisor and key point of contact for clients.
 



 Support business development through technical input in proposals and presentations.
 



 Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, authorities, and stakeholders.
 



 Lead technical negotiations and resolve complex project issues.
 



**Team Leadership \& Development** 




 Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary technical teams.
 



 Oversee recruitment, performance management, and succession planning.
 



 Promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence across departments.
 



**Financial \& Operational Oversight** 




 Contribute to business strategy and operational planning.
 



 Oversee project profitability, resource allocation, and cost control.
 



 Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance monitoring.
 



 Ensure efficient utilization of technical resources across projects.
 



**Compliance and Quality** 




 Ensure adherence to UAE regulations, authority requirements, and international standards.
 



 Implement and monitor QA/QC procedures across all projects.
 



 Drive innovation through adoption of new technologies, digital tools, and sustainable design practices.
 



 Stay updated on industry trends, codes, and emerging technologies.
 



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.
 



 Minimum 18–20 years of experience in architectural/engineering consultancy (pre and post tender stages).
 



 Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams.
 



 Strong knowledge of UAE codes, standards, and authority requirements (e.g., Dubai Municipality, DDA, etc.).
 



 Demonstrated experience in design management and construction supervision.
 


* For CV please send to: hr@gsengint.com

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
