We create trust in the digital age with integrated security technologies in three business areas: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co\-operation within G\+D.
   

  

 The whole world trusts us when it comes to physical or digital currencies. We increase the security and efficiency of the cash cycle in collaboration with central banks and the entire currency industry. As the market leader in advanced currency management, would you like to join us in shaping the future of payments?
   

  

**Scope and Purpose:**
* The Service Account Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all service\-related aspects from the implementation, to the maintenance\-phase of G\+D Solution projects, providing input in regards to service delivery to other project stakeholders in the offer phase, ensuring service readiness, supporting a seamless hand\-over of the customer solution to the service delivery engine to ensure a smooth start the service operation with the site acceptance and overseeing the delivery in the after sales phase.
* This role is critical in defining the service delivery strategy that complements the overall project objectives, managed by the Service Offer Manager and Solution Project Manager. The Service Account Delivery Manager ensures that the services are implemented and meet the highest standards of quality and efficiency, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction and project success.
* The role requires close collaboration with Service and Solution Sales.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Offer Phase: Service Delivery Model Definition: Develop and define a comprehensive service delivery model tailored to the project's specific needs and customer requirements. Providing input for service related costing. Collaborate with Service Offer Manager in Service Sales to ensure alignment between the service models, service pricing and the overall project deliverables. 3rd Party Service Supplier and Service Subcontractor Selection: Directing requirements for a supplier selection to ensure timely delivery of services and compliance with contractual terms in cooperation with the regional Subcontractor Manager. Identify and evaluate potential subcontractors who can meet the project's service requirements in alignment with the 3rd Party Service Product Manager and the regional Subcontractor Manager. Support the selection process, owned by Purchasing department, based on criteria such as capability, cost, quality, and reliability.
* Implementation Phase: Backup Service Related Tasks: Interface Management for all service related aspects between onsite teams (Field Service) and remote teams (Care Center, Service Sales, Service Backbone Operation) during the buildup phase. Initiating back\-to\-back agreements with suppliers according to the defined service delivery model for each solution element. Establish delivery processes based on decided legal setup for Order Management, 3rd Party services, Training and adaptation services in cooperation with Service Backbone Operation, leveraging standard wherever possible. Assure optimized service inventories in cooperation with Service Backbone Operation Subcontractor Contract Creation: Providing technical input for drafting and finalizing contracts with selected subcontractors, ensuring all service specifications and quality standards are clearly defined. Work closely with 3rd Party Service Product Manager, regional Subcontractor Manager, Legal and Purchasing department to ensure contracts are comprehensive and protect the interests of the organization. Ramp\-up of Service Employees: Oversee the recruitment and onboarding process for service team members. Ensure that service teams are appropriately staffed to meet project demands and timelines. Trainings for Service Employees: Identify skill gaps and develop training programs to enhance the competencies of service employees (internal and external), leveraging the G\+D Training Curriculum wherever possible. Coordinate and oversee the execution of training sessions, ensuring that all service employees are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge. Trainings for Customers: Identify training needs for customers. Coordinate and oversee the execution of training sessions, ensuring that the customer is trained for all relevant components. Leverage the G\+D Training Curriculum and Global Training infrastructure wherever possible. Coordination of Installation Related Tasks: Coordinate, plan and manage the installation of the G\+D Solution in close alignment with the Solution Project Manager. Oversee the onsite service teams to ensure that installations are completed on time and meet all quality standards. Site Acceptance Related Tasks: Ensure the successful transition from project to maintenance phase for all service related tasks. Manage the handover of responsibilities from the solution to the service team Reporting and Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all service processes and adjustments made during implementation phase. Provide input to project reports on service status, challenges, and achievements. Feedback and Improvement: Plan and conduct with reached SAT (Site Acceptance Test) the project closure process including the required lessons\-learned activities.
* Warranty and after warranty phase Service Initialization: Monitoring the closure of open items from project phase to completely hand\-over the solution into a maintenance phase. Assist the Field Service, Support and Backbone Operation teams during Hyper Care phase. Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction. Performance Management: Coordination of all activities needed to deliver committed service scope with high performance. Customer Management: Interface to the customer for technical discussions. Manage customer escalations and drive timely solution deliveries using the entire backup organization. Single Point of Contact: Overall coordination of delivering committed scope with respective delivery units (Field Service, Support, Training, Repair, Order Management, Adaptation) Contract Renewal: Support Service Sales during contract negotiation and renewal phase Setting Up and providing Service Fulfillment and commercial related Contract reporting based on committed scope Key Performance Indicators \- KPI (generic), individual targets will be agreed yearly Financials (To succeed financially, what should we deliver to our stakeholders?) Target Margin per annum overachieved \[%] \+ \[€] Operational (To satisfy our shareholders and customers, what business processes should we excel at?) Project completion within scope, timeline and quality Field Service and Support Delivery – Global KPIs Customer Satisfaction (To achieve our vision, how should we appear to our customers?) Successful Site Acceptance (SAT) Customer Satisfaction (C\-SAT) Index


**Requirements:**
* Personality / Skills / Professional Qualification \& Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or a related field
* Certification in Project Management
* Ability to lead and manage teams, to administer relationships as well as influence and manage subcontractors and suppliers effectively
* 10\+ years experienced in Automation systems and projects and technically proficient in Automation systems
* Proven track record in setting up services in complex, multi\-OEM projects \>5 years of experience in managing service delivery teams, including subcontractor selection, and contract management
* Extensive experience in dealing with customers and suppliers, including handling escalations and negotiations
* Ability to provide input on technical requirements and service specifications to meet service concept designs, cooperating with procurement, legal and sales teams
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate activities to deliver high service performance consistently
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interact with customers, team members, and other stakeholders
* Fluency in written and spoken English and French

**Role**
 The Project Manager will report to the Regional Director of Project Development. Based in our Dubai Corporate Office, you will support the delivery of ultra\-luxury hospitality and residential projects from inception to completion
   

  

 This role offers an opportunity to move client\-side, with strong potential for career growth. You will manage project workstreams, support day\-to\-day coordination and reporting, and work closely with consultants and internal teams to ensure delivery aligns with Aman’s quality, timeline, and commercial objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Support the Development Director in the day\-to\-day management and delivery of projects from inception through to completion and handover.
* Take ownership and responsibility for specific project workstreams, packages, or delivery scopes as assigned by the Development Director.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors and suppliers to ensure project objectives are achieved.
* Assist in monitoring project schedules, milestones and deliverables to ensure projects remain on programme.
* Prepare and maintain project trackers, action logs, risk registers and progress reports.
* Support the procurement and appointment process for consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers.
* Review consultant and contractor deliverables to ensure alignment with project briefs, programme and quality standards
* Work closely with Aman Technical Services and design teams to support the implementation of Aman brand standards and design objectives.
* Assist in managing project budgets, variation tracking, cashflow reporting and commercial administration.
* Coordinate tender processes, review submissions and support tender analysis and recommendations.


**Requirements:**
* 4\+ years’ experience in project management or construction management.
* Experience in managing the construction phase of a project is fundamental.
* Experience within luxury hospitality, residential or mixed\-use developments preferred.
* Ideally the candidate comes from a PM Consultancy background.
* Relevant university degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Project Management or similar discipline.
* Strong understanding of project delivery processes across design, procurement and construction stages.
* Experience coordinating consultants, contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Good commercial awareness with understanding of project budgets, procurement and contract administration.
* Strong organisational skills with ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.


**Benefits**
 At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

* Oversee the delivery and the activation of all marketing campaigns across all set channels.

* Work closely with the Business Director and the rest of the streams (Data Science, CRM, Experience Design \& Media) to support the through the content for all communications.

* Monitor the copywriting to ensure it is as per the brand tone of voice

* Cross social platform messaging with tone of voice and purpose taken into consideration

* Social listening tools and ability to analyze sentiments and drive positive change

 This role is abou
data.jd_text:
**A Role That Brings Leadership, Service Excellence \& Guest Experience Together**
 At Kimpton Sevn Dubai, we are looking for a Guest Experience Manager (Front Desk Manager) who understands that the Front Desk is more than a place—it is the heartbeat of the guest journey.
   

  

 This role is about creating seamless arrivals, memorable departures, and exceptional experiences in between. You will lead the Front Office team to deliver personalised service, operational excellence, and genuine hospitality while ensuring every guest interaction reflects the unique personality of Kimpton.
   

  

 Working closely with all hotel departments, you will create an environment where guests feel welcomed, recognised, and cared for from the very first moment.
   

  

 You are the leader behind the first impression and the lasting memory.
   

  

**One Arrival. One Experience. One Lasting Impression.**
 At Kimpton Sevn, the Front Desk is not simply a transactional touchpoint—it is where connections begin.
   

  

 As Guest Experience Manager, you ensure:
   

  

* Seamless and efficient guest arrivals and departures
* Personalised service throughout the guest journey
* Strong guest engagement and satisfaction across all touchpoints
* Consistent operational excellence and service delivery standards
* A highly motivated and guest\-focused Front Office team


 You transform routine interactions into memorable experiences.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 In a lifestyle hotel, guest experience starts and ends at the Front Desk.
   

  

 In this role, you support the Director of Front Office by:
   

  

* Leading daily Front Office operations and service delivery
* Creating exceptional guest experiences that drive loyalty and advocacy
* Supporting revenue opportunities through effective room management and upselling
* Building a positive and engaged Front Office culture
* Ensuring operational efficiency while maintaining personalised hospitality


 You ensure every guest feels genuinely welcomed and valued.
   

  

**Be the Leader Behind the Guest Journey**
 You are a visible, approachable, and service\-driven leader.
   

  

 Through your role, you will:
   

  

* Lead and inspire the Front Office team to deliver exceptional service
* Create memorable arrival and departure experiences
* Support VIP, repeat guest, and loyalty programme recognition
* Resolve guest concerns professionally and proactively
* Build strong relationships with guests and colleagues alike


 Your leadership creates confidence, consistency, and connection.
   

  

**What We'll Support You To Do**
 Deliver Exceptional Front Office Operations
   

  

 Lead daily operations with efficiency, professionalism, and attention to detail.
   

  

 Elevate Guest Satisfaction
   

  

 Create personalised and memorable guest experiences that exceed expectations.
   

  

 Develop and Inspire Teams
   

  

 Coach, mentor, and empower Front Office colleagues to perform at their best.
   

  

 Strengthen Service Culture
   

  

 Embed Kimpton's lifestyle hospitality philosophy into every guest interaction.
   

  

**The Gig**
 Reporting to the Director of Front Office, the Guest Experience Manager (Front Desk Manager) oversees the day\-to\-day operation of the Front Desk and Guest Services functions at Kimpton Sevn Dubai.
   

  

* The Opportunity: Lead the team responsible for creating first and last impressions
* The Focus: Guest experience, operational excellence, and team leadership
* The Impact: Deliver exceptional service while driving engagement, loyalty, and operational performance


 You will be at the centre of the guest experience journey.
   

  

**Stay Human**
 At Kimpton, hospitality is personal by design.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Lead with empathy, authenticity, and genuine care
* Create meaningful connections with guests and colleagues
* Foster a culture of warmth and personalised service
* Represent the personality and spirit of the hotel


 You help transform hospitality into human connection.
   

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day**
 No two days are the same; your responsibilities will span a range of operational and collaborative activities, including but not limited to:
   

  

**Front Office Operations**
* Oversee daily Front Desk operations and guest service delivery
* Ensure efficient check\-in, check\-out, and room allocation processes
* Monitor guest flow and operational performance throughout the day
* Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, and service standards


**Guest Experience \& Satisfaction**
* Actively engage with guests to understand their needs and preferences
* Ensure VIP, repeat guest, and loyalty programme recognition standards are maintained
* Handle guest concerns and service recovery situations professionally
* Drive guest satisfaction through proactive engagement and personalised service


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, coach, and mentor Front Office colleagues and supervisors
* Conduct daily briefings and operational communication sessions
* Support training, development, and performance management initiatives
* Promote teamwork, engagement, and accountability


**Revenue \& Commercial Awareness**
* Support room inventory management and room assignment strategies
* Identify opportunities for room upgrades and upselling initiatives

 A confidential private development group is seeking a Development Director to lead a major hospitality\-led real estate development in Iraq.
 



  





 This is a senior client\-side role focused on the planning, structuring, and progression of a landmark destination scheme including hotel, resort, residential, wellness, leisure, retail, infrastructure, and public realm components.
 



  





 Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, the Development Director will be responsible for driving the development strategy, coordinating consultants and operators, managing design progression, and ensuring the project is commercially, operationally, and technically aligned as it moves through early\-stage development and into delivery readiness.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 The Development Director will lead the development planning and execution strategy across a complex destination project, working closely with senior leadership, investors, hotel operators, branded residence partners, design consultants, technical advisors, commercial teams, and future delivery teams.

* Leading the overall development strategy, asset positioning, phasing, and land use planning

data.jd_text:
**Job Description:** 
 Project Manager – Civil Construction Works (Hydropower Plant Project)
 



**Location** 
 : Remote Project Site, Zambia Department: Project Delivery / Construction Reports To: Project Director / Construction Director Employment Type: Fixed\-Term Contract / Full\-Time Residential Site Role
 



  





**Please note that this role is based in Zambia and is a 2\-year project on a remote site** 




  





**Job Purpose** 




 The Project Manager – Civil Construction Works is responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, and control of all civil construction activities for a hydropower plant project located in a very remote area of Zambia. The role is accountable for delivering the civil works safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the required quality standards, while managing contractors, site resources, logistics, stakeholder interfaces, and compliance with environmental, social, and statutory requirements. The position requires strong leadership in a challenging remote\-site environment, including oversight of camp\-based operations, workforce welfare, and critical supply\-chain constraints.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •
 



 Lead and manage all civil construction works for the hydropower plant, including access roads, earthworks, river diversion works, intake structures, canals, penstocks foundations and supports, powerhouse civil works, tailrace structures, drainage systems, retaining structures, concrete works, and associated temporary works.
 



 •
 



 Develop and maintain the detailed construction execution plan, site mobilisation plan, look\-ahead schedules, and resource plans aligned with the overall project programme.
 



 •
 



 Manage contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and site supervision teams to achieve project milestones and maintain productivity in a remote\-site environment.
 



 •
 



 Monitor project progress against approved baseline schedule and budget; identify delays, risks, and cost overruns early and implement corrective actions.
 



 •
 



 Ensure all civil works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, quality plans, and contract requirements.
 



 •
 



 Coordinate closely with design, geotechnical, hydrology, electromechanical, environmental, social, and commissioning teams to manage interfaces and avoid disruption to the project programme.
 



 •
 



 Chair daily, weekly, and monthly construction meetings; issue action trackers and ensure timely close\-out of agreed actions.
 



 •
 



 Oversee site logistics for a remote location, including transport planning, materials delivery, fuel management, equipment availability, camp facilities coordination, and contingency planning for weather, road access, and supply\-chain interruptions.
 



 •
 



 Establish and enforce robust health, safety, environmental, and community protection standards across all civil work fronts.
 



 •
 



 Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with project HSE plans, permit\-to\-work requirements, incident reporting, emergency preparedness, and statutory obligations.
 



 •
 



 Lead quality assurance and quality control activities, including inspections, testing, non\-conformance management, punch lists, and handover documentation.
 



 •
 



 Review and approve contractor work programmes, method statements, inspection and test plans, progress claims, and change requests in line with delegated authority.
 



 •
 



 Manage commercial and contractual matters related to the civil works, including measurement, variations, claims support, progress certification inputs, and records management.
 



 •
 



 Prepare accurate weekly and monthly progress reports covering safety, schedule, cost, quality, risks, labour, plant, materials, and key decisions required.
 



 •
 



 Engage with clients, consultants, local authorities, regulators, and surrounding communities in a professional manner that supports project delivery and good stakeholder relationships.
 



 •
 



 Ensure compliance with Zambian legal and regulatory requirements, permit conditions, labour obligations, and environmental and social commitments applicable to the project.
 



 •
 



 Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and development of site engineering and supervisory personnel.
 



 •
 



 Drive continuous improvement in productivity, construction methodology, cost control, and field coordination.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 




 •Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering discipline.
 



 •
 



 Professional registration with the Engineering Institution of Zambia (EIZ) or eligibility to obtain registration will be an advantage.
 



 •
 



 Minimum of 10–15 years of relevant experience in heavy civil construction, with at least 5 years in a senior project management role.
 



 •
 



 Proven experience on hydropower, dam, water infrastructure, tunnelling, or similarly complex civil infrastructure projects.
 



 •
 



 Demonstrated experience managing construction works in remote or logistically challenging locations.
 



 •
 



 Strong knowledge of contract administration, construction planning, budgeting, cost control, and risk management.
 



 •
 



 Practical experience with concrete works, geotechnical conditions, temporary works, earthworks, foundations, and water\-retaining structures.
 



 •
 



 Good understanding of HSE management, quality systems, and environmental and social compliance requirements on infrastructure projects.
 



 •
 



 Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools such as Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, and standard Microsoft Office applications.
 



 •
 



 Valid driver’s licence and willingness to work on a full\-time residential basis at a remote site.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 •
 



 Strong leadership and team\-management capability in multicultural, camp\-based, and high\-pressure environments.
 



 •
 



 Excellent planning, coordination, and organisational skills.
 



 •
 



 Strong commercial awareness and decision\-making ability.
 



 •
 



 Ability to manage multiple contractors and interfaces simultaneously.
 



 •
 



 Clear communication and reporting skills.
 



 •
 



 High level of resilience, adaptability, and problem\-solving in isolated locations.
 



 •
 



 Strong commitment to safety, quality, ethics, and compliance.
 



 •
 



 Ability to build productive relationships with clients, consultants, authorities, community representatives, and internal teams.
 



  





**Working Conditions** 




 •Full\-time residential role based at a remote project site in Zambia.
 



 •Work is performed in a challenging construction environment with exposure to weather, rugged terrain, limited local services, and variable access conditions.
 



 •The role may require roster\-based work cycles, extended site presence, and irregular hours during critical construction phases.
 



 •Frequent interaction with contractors, plant operators, camp services, local communities, and regulatory stakeholders is expected.
 



 •The position holder must be physically fit for regular movement across active construction areas and remote work fronts.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 •
 



 Achievement of construction milestones in line with the approved baseline programme.
 



 •
 



 Performance against approved project budget and cost forecasts.
 



 •
 



 Safety performance, including proactive risk management and incident reduction.
 



 •
 



 Quality performance, including inspection pass rates, reduced rework, and timely close\-out of non\-conformances.
 



 •
 



 Effective contractor performance and productivity management.
 



 •
 



 Timeliness and accuracy of project reporting and decision support.
 



 •
 



 Compliance with legal, contractual, environmental, and social obligations.
 



 •
 



 Successful management of remote\-site logistics and continuity of operations.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on civil construction leader with deep infrastructure delivery experience, strong remote\-site management capability, and a proven record of safely delivering complex hydro or heavy civil projects under challenging logistical conditions. The person should be disciplined, practical, commercially aware, and capable of leading diverse teams while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, stakeholder management, and execution certainty.

We team up with passionate brands, clients and entrepreneurs to make their long\-term vision a reality through concept development, creative interior design, graphic design \& branding, franchising, advisory \& operational services and project management.
   

  

 Some of our clients include: Dubai Expo 2020, Marriott, Hilton, Waldorf Astoria, Harrods, Sushi Samba, Adrift Burger Bar, Nakheel Malls, Selfridges, Time Out Market, FIFA World Cup 2022, The National, and Tashas.
   

  

**Do you have a real passion for food and hospitality? Are you a foodie? Does the idea of creating world\-class restaurants, food halls and F\&B excite you?**
 As the world's leading hospitality agency, offering an outstanding 360 degree service to our clients, we are constantly striving to be the best and lead the sector in F\&B and hospitality consultancy. We need a driven and creative person to join our fun and dynamic team and have a direct contribution and client exposure on some of the world's leading projects.
   

  

**Requirements**
**The Role:** 
 Strategy \& Masterplanning Director
   

  

**The job location can be from any of our offices: London, Cairo, Dubai, Riyadh**
 The Strategy \& Masterplanning Director is responsible for leading and growing TGP's Strategy \& Masterplanning practice, ensuring the successful delivery of all strategic advisory projects while driving innovation, client satisfaction, commercial performance, and team development.
   

  

 As a senior client advisor, the Director will build trusted relationships with clients, taking the time to deeply understand their challenges, ambitions, operational realities, and commercial objectives. They will be responsible for translating complex business problems into clear strategic questions, designing analytical approaches that uncover actionable insights, and developing tailored solutions that create measurable value for clients.
   

  

 The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams through large\-scale research, data analysis, market evaluation, and strategic planning processes, transforming complex findings into compelling narratives, creative strategies, and inspirational recommendations that distinguish TGP from traditional consultancies.
   

  

 The role will also play a key part in growing TGP's market presence by identifying opportunities to expand client relationships, develop new service offerings, and position TGP as the leading hospitality strategy and experience consultancy in the region.

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Strategy, Masterplanning \& Client Advisory

* Master Planning

* Throughput Analysis

* Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships through cross\-selling, upselling, and introduction of wider TGP services
* Position TGP as a strategic partner rather than a transactional consultant


**Problem Definition \& Analytical Leadership**
* Lead teams through structured problem\-solving methodologies to clearly define client challenges and project objectives
* Design analytical frameworks and research methodologies that support evidence\-based decision making
* Guide teams through large and complex data analysis exercises, including market, operational, financial, customer, and competitive data
* Ensure insights are derived from data in a way that remains focused on solving client business problems rather than simply reporting findings
* Challenge assumptions and identify emerging trends, opportunities, risks, and innovation opportunities
* Drive clarity and alignment when working with ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting information


**Insight\-Led Strategy \& Innovation**
* Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling, and actionable strategic recommendations
* Develop creative and inspirational strategies that combine commercial rigour with innovative thinking
* Ensure recommendations are grounded in insight while pushing clients towards differentiated and future\-focused solutions
* Lead the creation of compelling strategic narratives that inspire confidence and support decision making
* Champion innovation, thought leadership, and trend analysis to ensure TGP remains ahead of industry developments
* Create strategic outputs that differentiate TGP from traditional consultancies through a combination of insight, creativity, practicality, and implementation focus
* Test new methodologies, technologies, and approaches while tracking effectiveness and outcomes
* Actively participate in TGP's 360 process from a strategic perspective
* Attend weekly Advisory and Design meetings to update leadership on project performance, team workload, and strategic opportunities
* Finance \& Profitability
* Monitor project billing, collection, and financial performance
* Develop and contribute to territory business plans and growth strategies
* Maximise revenue opportunities across strategy projects and wider TGP services
* Ensure profitability targets and project margins are achieved
* Negotiate third\-party consultant fees and supplier agreements

* Develop management information systems and performance reporting to support business growth and resource planning
* Contribute to annual budgeting and forecasting processes
* Review quarterly forecasts and identify performance variances
* Monitor territory profit and loss performance and recommend corrective actions where required
* Project Leadership


 (Where assigned as Project Lead)
   

  

* Coordinate and chair project meetings
* Manage project programmes, deliverables, and stakeholder communications
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to TGP quality standards
* Attend site visits, workshops, and client presentations
* Provide strategic leadership and subject matter expertise throughout project delivery
* Manage relationships with all external stakeholders
* Obtain stakeholder feedback and approvals as required
* Facilitate collaboration across TGP departments to ensure integrated project delivery

* Develop workforce planning and resource allocation strategies
* Mentor and coach team members in consulting, analytical thinking, client management, and strategic problem solving
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement

* Ensure resources are effectively managed to meet client commitments

* Maintain awareness of market trends, investor activity, hospitality innovation, and competitive movements
* Drive client retention, satisfaction, and long\-term relationship growth through TGP's 5E Customer Service philosophy
* Promote TGP's integrated 360 service offering across all client engagements
* Contribute to positioning TGP as the leading hospitality strategy, masterplanning, and experience consultancy in the region


**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Experience**
* Minimum 10 years' experience in hospitality consulting, real estate advisory, strategy consulting, destination development, or management consultancy

* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale strategic advisory projects

* Innovation \& Concept Development

* Analytical Problem Solving
* Creativity \& Innovation
* Executive Presence
* Influencing \& Negotiation
* Communication \& Storytelling
* Leadership \& Coaching
* Collaboration \& Team Building
* Results Orientation


**Benefits**
 TGP International Employee Benefits:
   

  

 Five\-Day Work Week: Standard Monday to Friday schedule.
   

  

 Hybrid Work Arrangement: Three days in the office and two days working remotely.
   

  

 Incentive Plan: Company incentive scheme offering up to 10%—5% for introductions and 5% for successful closures.

**Project Supply Chain Manager (PSCM)**
**Description**
 As the Project Supply Chain Manager for PGGI – Project Business Unit you will directly report to the Supply Chain Manager of PGGI – Business Unit.
   

  

 In this Role you will support the Business with SCM related to projects, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders – including Project Manager, Engineering, SCM, Quality, suppliers and Clients for the Project procurement activity, to resolve the obstacles and maintain the momentum. Lead and coordinate Supply Chain Execution across the project business portfolio, ensuring alignment with project and SCM Goals and timelines
   

  

 In close cooperation with the Tender/Project Project Team, you shall be responsible for End\-End execution of the Procurement/Supply Chain activity for the Projects.
   

  

**Roles**
* Pro\-active participation in Tender\-/ Capture Team during the kick\-off and tender progress meetings for selected target projects
* Identification of sourcing related opportunities and critical commercial, fiscal and legal conditions of the client´s tender specification and ensure flow over to the bidding documentation to suppliers / contractors
* Develop schedules, estimates, forecasts, and budgets to support all procurement requirements under the tender and project.
* Issue the project related Tender Sourcing Plan (TSP) based on the overall tender strategy, identified sourcing related opportunities and critical project conditions under consideration of the overall PG global/ territory sourcing strategies
* Collaborates with tender teams to identify new suppliers and supplier changes and ensures customer approval for Tender/project supplier list.
* Define, together with relevant Category Lead, the target price for main equipment
* Supporting tender responsible in issuing the project budget and time schedule by providing timely and accurate input from suppliers´ quotations incl. provision/ commitment of anticipated qualified improvement potentials
* If necessary, ensure adequate qualification measures and coordinate with SQE
* Participate in won\-/ lost\-order analysis and communicate sourcing relevant information to local\-, Territory\-, Global Strategic Sourcing Manager
* Ensuring management of all the necessary equipment and/or services for the project in terms of on\-time delivery, on\-quality delivery and on cost deliverables.
* Accountable for project schedule and cost as it pertains to SCM
* Pro\-active participation in project kick\-off\- and \-progress meetings during execution phase of the project
* first point of contact for overall sourcing\-/ supplier related topics towards the project execution team and coordination with the regional category Manager, Global Business Services (GBS), Transport Management representative during entire execution period of the project
* Identification of sourcing related opportunities and critical conditions of the client´s contract.
* Issuing RFQ and finalizing the Purchase order.
* Develop the Project Procurement Plan (PPP) based on the deliverables from tender phase (such as Tender Sourcing Strategy, suppliers’ quotations), overall project sourcing strategy,
* Responsible that critical commercial, fiscal and legal conditions of the client´s tender specification are part of each project related order /sub\-contract and where not achievable a written “waiver” from Project Management is documented
* Update the Project Health Status on Monthly basis before the Project Risk Review.
* Document the PPP in the PG standard “PPP Template”, if not retrieved from Project Procure
* Communicate, maintain and update the PPP – as a min. on a monthly basis
* P/SCM is responsible for the entire scope of supply of the entire project
* Ensure that purchase orders are placed in compliance to the PPP to accepted and qualified suppliers only
* Establish together with Contracts Manager or Project Manager the project specific terms \& conditions (Special Conditions) and manage the negotiation of Purchase Orders including payment terms, delivery, pricing, terms and conditions, etc.
* Ensuring that all purchase orders are accurate, approved and released in a timely manner.
* the application during negotiation and purchase order award
* Resolve any issues which could adversely affect the suppliers’ delivery, quality, price, etc. and where required involve Global, Division, BU, Territory Category Leaders, Lead Strategic Sourcing Manager, and Territory SCM
* Monitors the delivery status (forecast and actual) for all products/services (including other deliverables e.g. documentation, etc) and updates the project team accordingly by the adoption of a proactive expediting regime
* Monitor compliance to health and safety as well as business ethics within operational work, contracts and negotiations
* Ensure that the finance function is informed in a timely manner of all procurement activities and coordinate with the finance function on all outstanding payment issues with suppliers.
* Ensures compliance with all Group, Division and BU instructions and guidelines as they apply to the project.
* Ensures proper recording of potential claim/counter claim events, related to delays of goods/documentation, etc. and is responsible for the coordination of the conclusion/closure of these events in line with the project criteria for said.
* Ensure a PPP is available and updated for all projects worked on; including all schedules, estimates, forecasts, and budgets to support all procurement requirements. This should include all expediting data as well as spend data as a minimum.
* Update all the KPI as per the time line and provide the monthly summary to the LOUSCM Manager monthly .
* Ensures purchase order generation and invoice reconciliation comply with the requirements of the local unit.
* Ensures an accurate and up to date claims and opportunities register is available for review as required by the project team and/or management for all purchased items (where applicable).


**Knowledge, Skills, Experience**
* Master’s or bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline or any other qualification that is deemed suitable for the role.
* Thrives in a high\-paced, international environment and enjoys collaborating across diverse business areas and regions.
* Brings a strong technical and commercial interest and is motivated to grow within a Project SCM role with a structured,service \-minded and communicative approach.
* Technical knowledge on Substation, STATCOM products. Good knowledge of processes in large and complex industrial or turnkey contracts
* Proficiency in procurement software, solid skills in MS office and experience working with business software such as SAP, SAP Ariba or other ERP systems.
* Knowledge of Contract Conditions/Law, International Sourcing and vendor management best practices and Negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment, cross\-functional environment.
* Demonstrate dynamic, social teamwork skills combined with strong leadership and high level of cooperation.
* Hold experience from Project Procurement and is fluent in both written and spoken English .
* Good English both written and spoken
* Minimum 10\-15 years of professional experience in a project environment \& supply chain function
* Strength in commercial/Contracts/legal aspects of procurement.
* Excellent communication \& proven negotiation skills
* Drive to continuously create results and innovative solutions
* Skilled communicator who can interface with numerous external and internal parties at different levels in a project environment

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Project Manager in Facilities Management to plan, execute, and oversee facilities projects and day\-to\-day maintenance operations across corporate sites. This role combines project delivery with hands\-on supervision of building systems, vendor management, and workplace services. You will ensure facilities are safe, compliant, cost\-effective, and support business continuity while delivering refurbishment, relocation, and infrastructure upgrade projects on time and within budget.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Facilities Project Management** 
 Lead end\-to\-end facilities projects: office fit\-outs, renovations, relocations, HVAC upgrades, electrical works, and space optimization. Define scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards. Manage contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders from initiation to handover.
   

  

**Maintenance Supervision**
 Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance for MEP systems, HVAC, fire safety, elevators, plumbing, and building fabric. Develop and monitor PPM schedules. Ensure SLA compliance for hard and soft services. Supervise in\-house technicians and third\-party vendors.
   

  

**Vendor \& Contract Management**
 Manage FM vendors for cleaning, security, landscaping, pest control, and technical services. Prepare RFPs, evaluate bids, and administer contracts. Monitor KPIs, conduct performance reviews, and ensure compliance with service agreements and safety standards.
   

  

**Compliance \& HSE**
 Ensure facilities comply with local building codes, fire \& life safety regulations, environmental standards, and corporate HSE policies. Coordinate audits, inspections, and statutory certifications. Lead incident reporting and corrective actions for facilities\-related issues.
   

  

**Budgeting \& Cost Control**
 Prepare and manage OPEX and CAPEX budgets for facilities operations and projects. Track costs, approve invoices, and identify cost\-saving opportunities. Provide monthly reporting on spend, variances, and asset lifecycle planning.
   

  

**Workplace \& Asset Management**
 Support space planning, asset tracking, and workplace services. Manage building access, utilities, and critical infrastructure uptime. Oversee small works and reactive maintenance requests via CAFM/Helpdesk systems.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management**

**About Woods Bagot – Architecture for Worlds Ahead** 




 We design places that meet the challenges and opportunities of our rapidly changing world. Our commitment to exploration, impact and community creates enduring, forward‑thinking outcomes, unlocking humanity’s highest potential. With a global design culture devoted to creativity, resilience, and purpose – we ensure every project contributes to our client’s vision, inspiring future generations.
 



  





 Woods Bagot is part of the 7C Network. The 7C Network is an integrated network of design and architecture companies that provides “Total Place Design,” a holistic approach to creating transformative environments. It combines capabilities from its constituent brands – including Woods Bagot, ERA\-co, Impact Futures, and Customs Bureau – to offer services in placemaking, sustainability, architecture and interior design, and luxury concepts.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Project Leader to join our Dubai Studio and play a key role in the successful design and delivery of major projects across the Middle East and Europe. The successful candidate will initially lead a significant rail infrastructure project before transitioning to support and lead other key projects across our diverse portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Architect who enjoys working across complex, multidisciplinary environments and is motivated by designing and delivering high\-profile projects that shape cities and communities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of major projects from planning and design through to construction and completion.
* Initially provide leadership on a significant rail infrastructure project, ensuring successful delivery against programme, budget, and design objectives.
* Manage project resources, budgets, and risk throughout the project lifecycle.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including architecture, engineering, planning, urban design, and specialist consultants.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, design coordination, and project review meetings.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and project governance processes.
* Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve project challenges.
* Support business development activities and contribute to the pursuit of new project opportunities.
* Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performing project environment.



  





**About You** 




 You are an experienced Architectural Project Leader with a proven ability to lead the design and delivery of complex, large\-scale projects. Combining strong design sensibility with effective project leadership, you are skilled at managing clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality architectural outcomes across all stages of a project's lifecycle.
 



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* 15\+ years' experience designing and delivering complex architectural projects.
* Previous experience working on rail projects.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large\-scale, design\-led projects with multiple stakeholders and complex coordination requirements.
* Experience working on transportation, rail, aviation, civic, mixed\-use, commercial, or other major development projects would be highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of architectural project delivery, including design management, consultant coordination, project planning, and contract administration.
* Excellent design leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Degree qualification in Architecture; professional registration or chartership is desirable.
* Experience working within the UAE or broader Middle East region, with an understanding of local project delivery processes and regulatory requirements.
* A collaborative leadership style with a passion for mentoring, developing, and inspiring team members.
* Strong appreciation of design quality, technical excellence, and the delivery of innovative architectural solutions.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Applicants are required to submit a resume and portfolio via our Project Leader \- Rail LinkedIn Job Post. Due to file upload restrictions we recommend providing a link to your portfolio within your resume. Applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or names from agencies. All personal data collected by us will be kept confidential and only used for recruitment purposes.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement: It is an essential requirement that at the time of applying for this position, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UAE.** 




  





**7C \- Total Place Design Network** 




 7C is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status. At 7C, we are committed to creating an environment where difference is celebrated, valued and respected, practices are equitable, and our people feel like they belong. We accept that none of us is smarter than all of us. We believe building a diverse workforce is the foundation to creativity and innovative design – it is only by working together that we can realise the potential of our people, clients and communities around us. Through our inclusive leadership and our truly global studio network, you will find your voice and have the support and flexibility required to bring your whole self to work and build an exceptional career.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly qualified and experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong technical background in infrastructure and/or master planning to lead and oversee complex Land Development projects within our organisation. The role will have a focus on KSA projects, either based in KSA or in UAE with a requirement for periodic travel to KSA to meet project requirements.
   

  

 The successful candidate will have extensive project management experience as well as a strong technical understanding in Land Development disciplines (master planning, infrastructure, transport planning, landscaping, sustainability). The ideal candidate will possess Middle East experience with the knowledge, skills and expertise to lead multi\-disciplinary land development teams and drive internationally significant Land development projects from inception to completion.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership – Lead and manage Land Development Projects (Master Planning, Transport Planning, Roads, Utilities, Landscape), ensuring alignment with Client objectives and regulatory requirements
* Team Management – Build and lead cross\-functional project teams, providing guidance, mentorship and motivation to team members to achieve project goals
* Client Interaction – Cultivate and maintain strong client relationships, understand their needs and ensure project deliverables meet or exceed client expectations whilst aligning with project budgets
* Cost and Resource Management \- Develop project budgets, monitor and control expenditures, and allocate resources efficiently to optimise project outcomes
* Risk Management \- Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure project success
* Scope and Schedule Management \- Develop a work breakdown structure for the project, create schedules, monitor and control project progress against schedule. Ensure scope and deliverables are well defined. Ensure variance and scope creep are identified and that change is adequately documented and managed
* Quality Management \- Manage and control quality on the project by implementing WSP processes and templates and instilling and maintaining a quality culture across the project.

Ensure communication is efficiently and accurately flowing into and out of the project, in accordance with business protocols. Evaluate stakeholder power and influence and ensure relevant feedback is considered and requisite approvals sought


**Qualifications**
* Proven project management experience on large and complex Land Development projects in the Middle East
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Land Development discipline (e.g. Civil Engineering, Utilities, Roads, Transport Planning, Master Planning)

**Project Leadership \& Delivery** 



* Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks.
* Manage multidisciplinary teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

 This role reports directly to the Head of Event Rentals and plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth delivery of projects across warehouse operations, logistics, transportation and on\-site event execution.

**Operational Leadership** 



* Lead, coach and develop the operations team across warehouse, logistics and event delivery
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, professionalism and continuous improvement
* Set clear expectations, monitor performance and support team development
* Recruit, train and onboard operational team members as the business grows



  





**Event Delivery \& Logistics** 



* Plan and oversee the successful delivery, installation and collection of rental equipment across multiple projects and venues

* Act as the primary operational decision\-maker when challenges arise and ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally

* Assist in responding to technical queries for tenders
* Assist in marketing in the related technical services to Clients.
* Frequent international travel, sometimes at short notice

****Who are we looking for?****

* As frequent travelers conduct vessel visits: BOSIET or FOET certification is required

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

**In This Role You Will**

data.jd_text:
The College of Engineering (CEN) at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applicants for the position of the Head of the Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (CHBE) starting Fall 2027\. The college is seeking a visionary academic leader with the responsibilities of ensuring smooth and successful operation and sustainable development of the department.
   

  

 The candidate for the position must hold earned degrees, including a doctorate, in chemical engineering or a related field. The candidate must have demonstrated leadership in research, as evidenced by her/his outstanding publication record. In addition, a demonstrated record of excellence in teaching, and in academic and relevant professional services is required. The selected individual will have the opportunity to develop and articulate a vision and long\-range plan for the department in teaching and in research strategy that embodies the relevant areas that are vital to the department and the region. Special consideration will be given to candidates with a clear vision and achievable goals that are in line with the college’s and university’s strategic plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate must be a dynamic, collaborative, visionary and innovative individual with demonstrated leadership experience that can promote the continued advancement of the department. He/she is expected to have strong communication skills to effectively engage with a wide variety of constituents within and outside the university. His/her leadership style should include positive attitude, transparency, integrity, trust, fairness, promptness and collegiality. In addition to the general and wide responsibilities of the department head position, as partially outlined in the
 *Faculty Handbook* 
 , the selected applicant will be required to:
   

  

* provide effective leadership with well\-defined plans to nurture and elevate the standard of the department, accompanied with the development of short\-term and long\-term strategies in alignment with the strategic plans of the college and the university
* ensure high\-quality teaching as well as holistic development of the students, using approaches such as technology supported delivery, problem\-based learning, and other cutting\-edge trends in engineering education, in addition to leading the continuous improvement of the curriculum
* facilitate the conduct of innovative and cutting\-edge research of high\-quality and impact and promote multidisciplinary research with the optimal use of research funds and research facilities
* empower, mentor, promote, inspire and support faculty and staff to develop and sustain excellence in teaching, research and service
* foster a positive culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among faculty and students
* improve continuously teaching, research and service through benchmarking
* lead the department in achieving student recruitment goals by establishing and implementing recruitment plans for undergraduate and graduate students
* enrich the students’ experience via enhanced services, exchange visits, invited speakers, field trips, student clubs, professional certifications, competitions, conferences, etc.
* secure full\-time and internship positions and provide undergraduate research experience to the students
* participate in outreach activities, including maintaining ties and collaborations with alumni, industry, government, advisory boards, other university units and community members, and maintaining involvement in local and international professional organizations
* advertise locally and publicly the achievements and expertise of the faculty, staff and students of the department through web, newsletters and media exposure to enhance the academic reputation of the program
* collect data systematically and continuously from the department to plan and execute informed decisions
* ensure and increase diversity and equity in faculty hiring and student recruitment
* maintain and actively promote a positive, safe, transparent, fair, open, respectful, collegial working environment at the department, college and university
* interact and communicate effectively with individual faculty, staff and students (and parents) on a range of professional and personal issues
* represent the faculty and staff and convey their needs to the college’s and university’s administration.
* oversee the department’s operations including scheduling, advising, registration, lab preparations, budget allocation, compliance and risk management, etc.
* review and coordinate faculty course releases, sabbaticals and leave without pay requests
* conduct fair faculty and staff annual evaluations and provide effective feedback
* evaluate faculty and staff for promotion and/or rolling contract decisions
* lead and manage accreditation visits
* performing other duties as needed or assigned by the Dean


 Applicants should fill out an application form and upload the required documents (PDF) using the following \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cen/empapp/apply.php?p\=CHE\-DH\-26\-01");"\>link. The required documents are a cover letter and a detailed curriculum vitae (including a teaching statement, a research statement, vision and goals for the department, list of courses that can be taught or were taught, and names of at least three references who would be willing to write letters of recommendation). Positions are open until filled. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 The Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering has approximately 200 undergraduate students, 15 graduate students, 12 full\-time faculty and 3 lab instructors. Students and faculty represent very diverse backgrounds and nationalities; approximately 90 nationalities are present on campus. The department offers a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, a Bachelor of Science in Chemical and Biological Engineering, and a Master of Science in Chemical Engineering.
   

  

 AUS is located in the Emirate of Sharjah (about 15 km from Dubai). AUS is an independent, not\-for\-profit, coeducational university, serving more than 5,700 students. Further information can be obtained here.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education's Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\. The Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering offered by the College of Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("http://www.abet.org/");"\>http://www.abet.org/.
