**HEAD OF SCIENCE (Physics or Biology Specialism)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Science (Physics or Biology Specialism)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Science (Physics or Biology Specialism) to lead the Science Department and join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Science. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at NAISAK. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of science performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be, students in classes across the Science will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 Since NAISAK offers a Sixth Form, knowledge of AS/A levels would be an advantage.
   

  

 Finally, you must also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor’s degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum. You will be preparing students at NAISAK for external examinations at IGSCE, AS \& A Level. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Science, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the Job Description of the role for the following information:
   

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the English National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced English language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 13,000 people working together to support our students’ success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master’s in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King’s College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you’ll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world’s most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**Essential**
**EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS SOUGHT**
* University degree in Physics or Biology
* Teaching qualification (QTS,PGCE/PGDE)
* At least 6 to 9 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum
* Extensive knowledge of the English National curriculum to IGCSE


**Desirable**
* Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
* Master’s degree, or other significant professional development
* Previous international experience


**PERSONAL QUALITIES SOUGHT**
* Fluent English speaker
* Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
* Reliability, loyalty and commitment
* Personal confidence and presence
* Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do’ approach
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
* Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
* Sense of humour and grace under pressure
* Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
* Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
* Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
* Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 Please apply for this vacancy using our recruitment portal.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application and the details of three professional references.
   

  

**Closing date for applications:** 
 30th June 2026
   

  

**Start date for this role:** 
 1st August 2026
   

  

**Selection Process**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of three professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**Safeguarding**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

data.jd_text:
**Why Join Us?** 




 At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.
 



 Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.
 



 You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.
 



 Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.
 



**About Rosewood Doha:** 




 Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra\-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155\-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. Our destination also houses Asaya, Qatar’s first members\-only social wellness club, complemented by Rosewood’s signature Manor Club for Club Room and Suite guests.
 



 Since opening in July of 2025, Rosewood Doha has been recognized with multiple international and regional accolades, including distinctions from the Michelin Guide, Forbes Travel Guide and Qatar Tourism \- reflecting the scale, ambition and standards of excellence behind the destination. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels \& Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience\-driven destinations.
 



**Our Associate Experience:** 




 We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. At Rosewood Doha, we offer a thoughtfully designed associate experience that supports your wellbeing, growth and life beyond work. This includes:
 



 \-
 
     
 
 A competitive salary and benefits package
 



 \-
 
     
 
 High\-quality associate accommodation in prime locations in the heart of Lusail and the Pearl
 



 \-
 
     
 
 A birthday day off (because your milestones matter!)
 



 \-
 
     
 
 Personalized development plans and continuous learning opportunities to support your career journey
 



 These benefits reflect our commitment to creating an environment where you thrive – professionally and personally – while building a meaningful career with us.
 



**Your Role:** 




**Administration:** 



* Ensures that the Food and Beverage activities are aligned with the respective Corporate Strategy, and that the Hotel actions have been implemented where appropriate.
* Oversees the preparation, reviews and updates individual Departmental Operations Manuals.
* Conducts regular divisional communications meetings and ensures that departmental briefings and meetings are effective and conducted as necessary.
* Liaises with Culinary Division.



**Guest Satisfaction:** 



* Ensures that all associates deliver the brand promise and provide exceptional guest service at all times.
* Ensures that associates also provide excellent service to internal customers in other divisions as appropriate.
* Spends time in public areas observing associate\-guest interaction and talking with guests, works through Department Heads to coach associates in guest service skills as necessary.
* Ensures that all guest and internal customer complaints are resolved in a quick and efficient manner.
* Maintains positive guest and colleague interactions with good working relationships.



**Finance:** 



* Maximises associate productivity through the use of multi\-skilling, multi\-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business as well as the expectations of the guests.
* Ensures that each profit centre (e.g. Outlet, Bar, Events) is operated in line with maximising profit while delivering on the brand promise.
* Ensures that each cost centre (e.g. Stewarding) operates with the lowest possible cost structure while also delivering on the brand promise to the guest.
* Assists in the preparation of the Annual Business Plan for Food and Beverage.
* Analyses business performance strategically to facilitate accurate and meaningful forecasting, involving the respective Department Heads as appropriate.
* Manages costs proactively based on key performance indicators, works with the respective Depa1tment Heads as appropriate.
* Ensures that all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to financial record keeping, money handling and licensing are adhered to, including the timely and accurate repo1ting of financial information.
* Assists in the inventory management and ongoing maintenance of hotel operating equipment and other assets. In particular, high use assets such as chinaware, glassware and flatware.
* Participates in weekly yield and revenue management meetings actively, oversees the appropriate pricing structures to maximise yield and overall profits in Outlets and Events.
* Responsible for control of beverage programme including recipes, inventory and progressive menu development.
* Reviews uniform replacement schedule as well as coordinating upgrade reviews with Hotel Manager.



**Marketing:** 



* Assists in the preparation, utilisation and update of the Annual Marketing Plan, broken down as necessary by department.
* Evaluates local, national and international market trends, vendors and other hotel/restaurant operations constantly to make sure that the hotel's operations remain competitive and cutting edge.
* Encourages Department Heads to look for Marketing and Public Relations opportunities to increase awareness and ultimately business.



**Operations:** 



* Ensures that all company minimum brand standards have been implemented, and that optional brand standards have been implemented where appropriate.
* Monitors all operations, especially during peak business periods, working through the respective Department Head to make adjustments where necessary.
* Ensures that all Food and Beverage Fundamentals are introduced, implemented and consistently maintained.
* Ensures that the Food and Beverage Division responds to the results of the Consumer Audit and to ensure that the relevant changes are implemented.
* Works closely with other Executive Committee members in a supportive and flexible manner, focusing on the overall success of the hotel and the satisfaction of hotel guests.
* Ensures that Food and Beverage associates work in a supportive and flexible manner with other departments, in the spirit of "We work through Teams".
* Ensures that all associates are up to date with the availability of seasonal and new products on the market.
* Tastes and monitors the food and beverage products served throughout the operation, provides feedback where appropriate.
* Maintains and assists in outlets during the absence of respective managers.



**Talent and Culture:** 



* Oversees and assists in the recruitment and selection of all Food and Beverage associates. Ensures that Department Heads follow hotel guidelines when recruiting and use a competency\-based approach to selecting their associates.
* Oversees the punctuality and appearance of all Food and Beverage associates, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene, according to the hotel and department's grooming standards.
* Maximises the effectiveness of Department Heads by developing each of their skills and abilities through the appropriate training, coaching, and/or mentoring.
* Conducts annual Performance Development Discussions with key Food and Beverage associates and supports them in their professional development goals. Ensures that they in turn conduct annual Performance Development Discussions with their associates.
* Ensures that each Department Head plans and implements effective training programmes for their associates in coordination with the Talent Development Manager and their Departmental Trainers.
* Encourages associates to be creative and innovative, challenging and recognising them for their contribution to the success of the operation.
* Ensures that all associates have a complete understanding of and adhere to associate rules and regulations.
* Ensures that associates follow all hotel, company and local rules, policies and regulations relating to fire and hazard safety, and security.
* Feedback the results of the Associate Engagement Survey and ensure that the relevant changes are implemented.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 A landmark, large\-scale mixed\-use destination development is underway in Qatar — one of the most ambitious leisure, retail, and real estate projects in the region. Spanning entertainment, hospitality, retail, and residential components across a significant land area in the greater Doha area, this project represents a generational investment in Qatar's tourism and economic diversification ambitions.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The project is at a pivotal stage of development, and we are seeking an exceptional Contracts \& Commercial Director to lead the full commercial and contracts function from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Contracts \& Commercial Director will be the most senior commercial authority on the project. This is a leadership role with strategic accountability for all contracts, procurement, cost management, and commercial governance across the entire development programme — spanning design, construction, fit\-out, retail leasing infrastructure, and operational commissioning phases. The successful candidate will build and lead a high\-performing commercial team, establish robust contract frameworks, protect the project's financial interests, and ensure that all commercial decisions are aligned with the project's master development strategy.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* **Contracts Management**
* Own end\-to\-end contract strategy, administration, and execution across all project workstreams including civil works, MEP, fit\-out, retail, leisure, and hospitality packages
* Lead the preparation, negotiation, and award of all major contracts (FIDIC, NEC, bespoke forms), ensuring appropriate risk allocation and commercial protection
* Manage the full claims lifecycle — anticipation, assessment, negotiation, and resolution — minimising exposure and disputes
* Establish and maintain a contract register, variation management system, and claims log with full governance and audit trail
* Interface with legal counsel on contractual disputes, arbitration, and enforcement matters
* 
* **Commercial Management**
* Develop and implement the project's overarching commercial strategy in alignment with the CEO and development board
* Own the project cost plan, budget, and cost\-to\-complete reporting, providing accurate and timely commercial reporting to senior leadership and ownership
* Lead value engineering initiatives without compromising design intent or operational quality
* Drive procurement strategy — packaging, market engagement, tendering, evaluation, and award — for all consultants, contractors, and specialist vendors
* Establish commercial governance frameworks including delegation of authority, approval workflows, and commercial risk registers
* Oversee the benchmarking of contract prices against market rates and comparable regional projects
* 
* **Retail \& Real Estate Commercial**
* Provide commercial oversight on retail leasing structures, anchor tenant agreements, and fit\-out contribution frameworks
* Advise on commercial terms for real estate sales, land disposal, and development management agreements
* Support the delivery of F\&B, hospitality, and entertainment operator agreements from a contracts and commercial perspective
* 
* **Leadership \& Team Building**
* Recruit, build, and mentor a multi\-disciplinary commercial team (quantity surveyors, contracts managers, commercial analysts)
* Foster a high\-performance, ethical, and collaborative commercial culture across the project
* Act as a trusted commercial advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team
* Represent the project in dealings with government entities, master developers, and regulatory bodies where commercial matters arise



  





  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Essential
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in contracts and commercial management, with at least 5 years at Director level
* Proven experience on large\-scale retail, real estate, or mixed\-use destination development projects (total contract value ≥ QAR 500M)
* Deep expertise in FIDIC (Red, Yellow, Silver Books) and/or NEC contract suites
* Demonstrated track record in claims management, dispute avoidance, and commercial dispute resolution
* Experience building and leading commercial teams in a project delivery environment
* Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline
* 
* Highly Desirable
* MRICS / FRICS qualification or equivalent professional accreditation
* Prior experience on landmark GCC destination, leisure, or entertainment projects (e.g. Lusail City, Place Vendôme Qatar, Diriyah Gate, NEOM, Yas Island, Expo City)
* Familiarity with Qatari regulatory, procurement, and legal framework
* Experience with retail leasing commercial structures and entertainment/hospitality operator agreements
* Arabic language proficiency (advantageous, not mandatory)
* Master's degree in a relevant discipline

***About HEC Paris, Doha***




  





**﻿** 




 Founded in 1881 by the Paris Chamber of Commerce, HEC Paris is a leading European business school with the ambition to make a positive impact on both business and society. Its mission is driven by a unique “Think, Teach, Act” approach, aimed at fostering a more inclusive, sustainable, and prosperous world. With 167 research professors from around the globe, HEC Paris produces and shares cutting\-edge knowledge with over 5,000 students from more than 130 countries. Its campus serves as a true laboratory of innovation and dialogue, fully engaged with the world’s diversity and global challenges.
 



 In 2010, HEC Paris joined Qatar Foundation to bring world\-class management education programs and research to Doha and the region. Through its portfolio of programs and its local research activities, HEC Paris, Doha contributes to corporate competitiveness in the global economy, fully aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030 and supporting the transformation of Qatar into a sustainable, competitive, and knowledge\-based economy. In addition to offering degree programs, the school partners with corporate clients in Qatar and the region to design and deliver customized executive programs addressing current business and organizational challenges.
 



 HEC Paris is an exceptional workplace, located in state\-of\-the\-art premises in downtown Msheireb, at the heart of Doha. Joining HEC Paris, Doha is a unique opportunity to be part of a close\-knit community of talented individuals united around five core values: Curiosity, Excellence, Diversity, Responsibility, and Entrepreneurial Spirit.
 



 https://www.qatar.exed.hec.edu/
 



  





***Job Description***




  





  





 The Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships is responsible for generating and growing corporate revenue by leading the acquisition, development, and retention of strategic B2B clients for Executive Education programs in Qatar and the GCC region. The role owns a portfolio of key accounts, drives complex sales cycles, and builds long\-term corporate partnerships while ensuring commercial performance, pipeline health, and profitability targets are consistently achieved.
 



**Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Drive corporate sales performance by developing and executing sales strategies aligned with institutional growth objectives
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of new and existing corporate clients using CRM tools, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting
* Identify new market opportunities and growth levers, including sector expansion, partnerships, and account penetration strategies
* Prepare and validate all commercial proposals and contracts in coordination with relevant stakeholders
* Conduct client meetings, presentations, and negotiations with senior decision\-makers
* Draft business proposals and ensuing contracts and validate all out\-going client commercial proposals, conduct client visits and presentations, working with all relevant internal stakeholders – Faculty, Legal, Operations, etc. – throughout the client lifecycle;
* Oversee account management plans for key clients, ensuring renewals, upselling, and cross\-selling opportunities are systematically pursued
* Work closely with the Chief Growth and Impact Officer on pricing strategies and profitability models to ensure sustainable margins
* Monitor revenue, pipeline health, and program profitability



**Program Design \& Experience** 



* Partner with Faculty / Subject Matter Experts to translate client needs into impactful learning solutions with clear objectives and learning outcomes
* Lead learning design by structuring journeys, modalities, and engagement methods, ensuring a cohesive end\-to\-end participant experience
* Ensure seamless handovers from Sales to Operations, maintaining alignment between client expectations and program delivery
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, proposal quality, and client experience
* Act as a liaison with Executive Education peers on HEC Paris Main Campus to align standards, innovation, and best practices



**Relationship Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term, trusted relationships with senior leaders and HR/L\&D stakeholders across client organizations
* Represent the institution at client events, launches, graduation ceremonies, and professional forums to strengthen market visibility and partnerships



**Team Leadership** 



* Lead and manage direct reports, driving performance and accountability through clear objectives and KPIs, progress monitoring, regular check\-ins, and timely corrective actions when needed.
* Build team capability and efficiency by identifying development needs, providing on\-the\-job coaching, encouraging knowledge\-sharing, and promoting innovative ideas to streamline workflows and boost productivity.



  





***Qualifications***




  





  





**Education and experience** 



* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or a related discipline
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in B2B sales, business development, partnerships, or consulting within a services, education, or professional development environment
* Experience in Executive Education, Talent Development, Learning \& Development, or Leadership Development is highly preferred
* Experience in designing, pricing, and selling customized corporate learning solutions, including blended and digital formats
* Experience in GCC markets is a strong advantage.



**Skills and competencies** 



* Excellent written and spoken English. Arabic and French are advantageous.
* Strong consultative selling and negotiation capabilities with the ability to close high\-value, multi\-stakeholder deals
* Excellent presentation, communication, and proposal development skills
* Solid financial acumen with experience in pricing strategies, profitability modeling, and margin management
* Strong account management and relationship development capabilities
* Ability to analyze pipeline performance, forecasting data, and sales metrics to drive decisions
* Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools



**Ways of working** 



* Highly results\-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Client\-centric, collaborative, and relationship\-oriented approach
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform under pressure
* Flexible to travel and willing to adapt working hours to business needs

data.jd_text:
The Head of Network Infrastructure Operations is responsible for defining and executing the organization's network infrastructure strategy while ensuring operational excellence across all network services.
 



  





 This role oversees network operations, infrastructure modernization, automation initiatives, security compliance, vendor management, and the delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure network environments aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Operational Excellence \& NOC Management** 




  




* Lead and oversee the 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) to ensure proactive monitoring and rapid incident response.
* Establish, measure, and continuously improve network Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage engineering teams operating in high\-pressure, mission\-critical environments with strict uptime requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and event organizers to translate operational requirements into technical network solutions.
* Lead the response to major incidents and ensure detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective action plans are completed.



  





**Strategic Infrastructure Roadmap** 




  




* Develop and execute the long\-term network infrastructure strategy.
* Design and implement scalable enterprise network architectures across LAN, WAN, Data Center, and Cloud environments.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies such as SD\-WAN, WiFi 6E, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Lead infrastructure transformation initiatives, including the retirement of legacy platforms and migration to modern network technologies.



  





**Network Automation \& Innovation** 




  




* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational activities and improve efficiency.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated change management processes for network operations.
* Standardize infrastructure deployment and configuration management using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and Python.
* Promote innovation and continuous improvement across network engineering and operations teams.



  





**Risk Management \& Security Compliance** 




  




* Partner with Information Security teams to implement Zero Trust networking principles and enterprise firewall policies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory frameworks including ISO 27001 and SOC 2\.
* Develop and maintain disaster recovery (DR) strategies and business continuity plans.
* Conduct regular testing and validation of recovery procedures and operational resilience capabilities.



  





**Financial \& Vendor Management** 




  




* Own and manage annual network infrastructure CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
* Lead negotiations with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), hardware vendors, and managed service providers.
* Manage vendor performance and conduct regular business reviews with strategic technology partners.
* Ensure investments deliver measurable business value and operational efficiency.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 12–15 years of experience in Network Engineering, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale, multi\-vendor enterprise network environments including Cisco, Arista, HPE, and related technologies.
* Deep expertise in global backbone and enterprise networking technologies, including BGP, MPLS, SD\-WAN, and VXLAN.
* Strong experience with hybrid cloud connectivity solutions, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS Direct Connect, and Azure ExpressRoute.
* Proven hands\-on experience with data center networking technologies, including Cisco ACI, Cisco Nexus Switching, Cisco UCS, and VMware NSX.



  





**Competencies** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Expert\-level knowledge of centralized network controllers and software\-defined fabrics such as Cisco ACI, VMware NSX, or equivalent technologies.
* Deep expertise in enterprise and service provider routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EVPN.
* Strong understanding of encapsulation and transport technologies such as VXLAN and MPLS.
* Proven ability to design and manage virtual overlays, logical network segmentation, and micro\-segmentation security policies.
* Strong knowledge of network automation and orchestration using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and related technologies.
* Advanced expertise in Layer 4–Layer 7 technologies including load balancing, traffic engineering, and Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB).
* Expertise in integrating firewalls, IDS/IPS solutions, and Zero Trust security frameworks within enterprise network architectures.
* Advanced knowledge of deep packet inspection, flow telemetry, network observability, and proactive performance monitoring.
* Ability to optimize latency, throughput, availability, and overall network performance.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 




  




* Valid CCIE Certification (Mandatory).
* CCNP
* ITIL Foundation
* PMP
* Azure Certified Advanced Networking

data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





**About Shifamed** 




 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





 Description:
 



 This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of quality systems and practices. This position will oversee and ensure that the development, manufacture, testing and release of products are performed according to the applicable federal and state regulations, international standards, and the Company’s Quality Policy.
 



  





 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
 


* Ensure compliance with applicable Quality System Regulations and standards, including FDA QSR, ISO 13485, MDR, GMP, and Design Controls.
* Partner with R\&D and Operations to establish and maintain quality requirements throughout product development, transfer, manufacturing, and post\-market activities.
* Lead and maintain Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files, and associated quality documentation for products and processes.
* Develop and implement quality engineering activities including design verification/validation, process validation, equipment qualification, test method validation, and first article inspections.
* Support manufacturing quality activities including inspection processes, nonconformance investigations, CAPA, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee manufacturing and quality documentation including procedures, inspection instructions, Lot History Records, and Bills of Materials.
* Manage supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, audits, source inspections, supplier controls, and ongoing quality performance monitoring.
* Prepare for, host, and support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits and inspections.
* Coordinate quality system training and promote company\-wide quality system awareness and compliance.
* Support complaint handling, MDR/vigilance reporting, field actions, and investigation of product or process failures.
* Serve as Quality representative on cross\-functional project teams and act as site Management Representative and/or Quality signature authority as required.
* Lead and manage Quality Assurance resources to ensure effective execution of quality system and regulatory compliance activities.
* Other duties as assigned.



  





 Education \& Work Experience:
 


* Bachelors or Masters in Engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience
* 15\+ years of Quality or Technical Management experience in the medical device industry or a related field.
* Previous direct people management experience.
* Previous experience bringing a company into regulatory compliance and approval, preferred.
* Solid knowledge of FDA regulations and interpretation of FDA regulations, guidelines, and policy statements.
* Solid knowledge of international regulations, standards, and guidelines (i.e. MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 and collateral standards, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, FDA guidance documents for cybersecurity).
* Ability to train others in processes and procedures.
* Excellent communications skills (both written and verbal) required.
* Ability to work effectively across functional lines to reach effective outcomes for the business.
* Ability to travel as required.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* This position is responsible for cost containment through the proper use, handling and maintenance of records, reports, supplies and equipment.
* Identifies potential expense reductions through cost control.
* Analyzes operational problems and establishes controls.
* Reviews timesheets and forwards them to the Executive Chef for approval.
* May prepare a variety of reports and letters utilizing personal computer system and equipment.
* Ensures that items are requisitioned in correct quantities, within acceptable timeframes and in accordance with established control procedures.
* Conducts workstation spot checks to ensure items are correctly stored to minimize deterioration and waste.



  





**MOTIVATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Monitors and manages the various assigned workstation functions.
* Monitors the assignment of duties and responsibilities to their staff.
* Observes and evaluates staff and work procedures to ensure quality standards and service are met.
* Makes recommendations regarding personnel actions such as new hire requests and discharges, to ensure adequate and continuous staffing.
* Inspects workstations, work areas, equipment, etc. to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 




  




* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
To establish, lead and direct the architecture and implementation of Naufar’s Information Technology (IT) strategy, in order to effectively and efficiently develop and deliver fit\-for\-use IT infrastructure, integrated business solutions and IT support services to support Naufar’s strategy and objectives
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




**Corporate Strategy** 



* As a member of the senior management, lead the development of the strategies and plans for the Information Technology department and support in the development of the Operations division strategy to ensure that Naufar executes its mission effectively, achieves organizational objectives and realizes its vision.
* Lead the translation of Naufar’s overarching strategy into business plans for the Information Technology Department and ensure effective performance monitoring and management, in order to achieve department’s strategic objectives.



**Leadership** 



* Ensure the achievement of the departmental strategic objectives by setting priorities and objectives for direct reports, managing performance, developing a highly qualified talent pool and motivating them, and providing strategic direction, in order to maximize performance, improve productivity and reach operational excellence.
* Work closely with the Assistant COO to raise employee awareness and commitment to Naufar’s vision, mission, values and corporate strategy, in order to increase workforce engagement.



**Organization Structure** 



* Define efficient and effective organization structure for the department in coordination with the Organization Development and Human Resources to ensure optimum resource utilization, fast decision\-making and better communication among staff.



**Budget Planning** 



* Provide direction on department’s budget preparation in line with the department’s annual business plan.
* Ensure effective and continuous monitoring of financial performance of the department against its budget so that the organization is aware of anticipated costs and/or revenues, is able to identify areas of unsatisfactory performance, and can capitalize on potential improvement opportunities.



**Enterprise Architecture** 



* Manage effective conceptualization and implementation of IT architecture, in order to ensure consistency and optimization of IT operations.
* Direct and guide the continuous improvement of IT architecture, systems and processes, in line with the latest global technologies and IT standards.
* Ensure compliance of IT systems with relevant international standards and local laws and regulations, especially with respect to information security and data privacy.



**Demand and Delivery Management** 



* Direct and guide the comprehensive translation of business needs into IT projects and ensure timely, quality and efficient execution, in order to ensure effective IT support to other departments. Ensure adherence to time, cost and quality, in order to ensure efficient and effective delivery of services.
* Monitor quality and quantity of IT capacity to ascertain meeting current and future demands.



**System Development** 



* Provide overall direction to the system development team to direct and lead the effective analysis of user requirements, development/enhancement of IT systems as per business priority in order to ensure effective IT services management in accordance to business requirements.



**IT Operations and Support** 



* Direct and oversee IT operations so that they meet and exceed the service levels agreed with users and conforms to relevant technical and security standards within budgeted cost.
* Provide overall direction to infrastructure management team in order to ensure effective establishment and maintenance of a scalable and agile IT infrastructure that meets emerging and changing business requirements.
* Provide strategic direction on infrastructure related upgrades, both from system and network perspectives, to facilitate optimum service delivery.
* Ensure implementation of IT security policies and systems to safeguard and protect all IT operations ensuring the reliability and integrity of data.



**IT Performance Management** 



* Ensure effective development and implementation of quality assurance and control processes and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to facilitate provision of high quality IT services in accord with defined quality standards and SLAs.
* Ensure effective execution of IT audits, and collaboration of all relevant parties to achieve defined quality standards.
* Direct the development and management of IT services sourcing strategy and vendor management policies \& guidelines, in order to ensure meeting IT requirements in accordance with statutory and Naufar’s policies with optimum benefits to the organization.



**IT Projects and Programs** 



* Based on the IT strategy and annual plan, evaluate the viability of IT projects and develop a prioritized project list based on commercial feasibility and Naufar’s business requirements.
* Develop the IT project methodology and framework including development of detailed project scope and user requirements, required resources, outsourcing strategy, cost schedule, risk management plan, testing plan etc., to ensure project gets execution within the quality, time and approved costs.



  





**Professional/Academic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT engineering or equivalent from a reputable university.



**Experience:** 



* 12 years of relevant IT experience in healthcare industry, with at least 5 years of experience in a managerial role.
* Strong knowledge on IT Governance and best practices such as ITIL, COBIT or ISO 20000\.
* Knowledge of the healthcare sector in Qatar.

**About Commercial Bank**
 Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services. We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.
   

  

 By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work\-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Head of Security Operations is responsible for ensuring the organization’s information assets remain secure, resilient, and available. In this dual capacity, the role not only leads the operational defense of the enterprise—managing the Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management—but also supports the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) in shaping and executing the broader cybersecurity strategy.
   

  

 The role requires a balance of technical expertise and leadership, driving continuous improvement in monitoring, detection, and response capabilities while also contributing to policy development, security awareness, and long\-term resilience planning.
   

  

 The Head of Security Operations will establish robust processes, optimize security tools, and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations.
   

  

 This position provides strategic oversight across Security Operations acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and a bridge between technical teams and executive stakeholders. It ensures that security operations are tightly aligned with enterprise risk objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. By coordinating with other security, IT, and business teams, this role ensures that security operations are efficient, proactive, and strategically aligned.
   

  

 Ultimately, the Head of Security Operations acts as both the guardian of the organization’s digital environment and a key leader in advancing enterprise\-wide cybersecurity maturity, ensuring threats are identified and mitigated quickly while evolving controls to meet emerging challenges.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership
   

  

* Oversee day\-to\-day security operations, including Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and vulnerability management.
* Ensure timely triage, investigation, and resolution of security incidents.
* Maintain and optimize security monitoring tools, SIEM, and endpoint protection platforms.
* Develop and enforce operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and SLAs for incident handling.


 Strategic Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and execute the Security Operations strategy aligned with organizational risk appetite and business objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, threat intelligence integration, and advanced analytics.
* Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to design secure solutions for new business initiatives.
* Lead maturity assessments and roadmap development for SOC capabilities.


 Business Alignment
   

  

* Act as a trusted advisor to business units, ensuring security controls support operational efficiency and customer trust.
* Translate technical risks into business impact for executive reporting.
* Collaborating with IT, legal, and business units to align security with organizational objectives.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Leadership
* Ability to define and execute a long\-term security operations vision to combat existing and future threats.
* Risk Management
* Expertise in identifying, assessing, and mitigating cyber risks.
* Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, QCB and NCSA)
* Technical Acumen
* Deep knowledge of security operations cybersecurity technologies
* Familiarity with emerging threats and security innovations.
* Incident Response \& Crisis Management
* Capability to lead during security breaches and ransomware attacks.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Ability to translate technical risks into business language for executives and regulators.
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills.
* Governance \& Compliance
* Experience in implementing security policies, audits, and regulatory reporting.
* Liaison with regulators and external auditors.
* People Leadership
* Build and lead high\-performing security teams.
* Drive a culture of security awareness across the organization.
* Analytical \& Decision\-Making Skills
* Data\-driven approach to security investments and risk prioritization.
* Ability to make quick, informed decisions under pressure.


**Qualifications \& Expereince**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree (Master’s or MBA) preferred.
* 15\+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles driving enterprise\-wide security initiatives.
* Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent industry\-recognized credentials.
* Extensive experience managing SOC operations and large\-scale incident response, including crisis management and executive\-level communications.
* Proven track record in developing and implementing enterprise security strategies, aligning technical controls with business risk and regulatory requirements (PCI DSS, ISO27001, NIST, GDPR).
* Expertise in governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) frameworks, including policy development, audit readiness, and regulatory engagement.
* Strong background in cloud security (Azure, AWS, GCP), identity management, and data protection, with hands\-on experience in Microsoft security tools (Purview, Entra ID, Defender).
* Leadership in building and mentoring high\-performing security teams, fostering collaboration across IT, risk, and business units.
* Experience in vendor and third\-party risk management, ensuring secure supply chain practices and resilience.
* Skilled in workflow automation and orchestration (e.g., SOAR) to optimize detection, response, and compliance processes.
* Adept at executive and board\-level communication, translating complex technical risks into clear business impacts and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrated success in driving digital transformation securely, balancing innovation with robust risk management and regulatory oversight.


**Why Commercial Bank**
* Best Performing Bank in Qatar in The Banker’s prestigious Top 1000 World Banks Rankings 2025\.
* Best Digital Bank in the Middle East 2024 by World Finance and Best Mobile Banking App in the Middle East 2024 by Global Finance.
* An Innovation\-Driven, Digital\-First Environment where employees work with the latest tools and technologies to redefine banking
* Opportunities for Global Partnerships \& International Exposure, connecting employees with global networks and perspectives.
* A focus on Employee Well\-being \& Work\-Life Balance, ensuring a healthy and supportive environment for all team members
* Competitive Compensation \& Benefits that ensure our employees are rewarded for their dedication and performance
* A strong Commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion, fostering a culture that values every individual’s unique perspective


 At Commercial Bank, we don’t just offer careers, We shape futures by pioneering
 **digital transformation**

 approach to redefine banking through

data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous l’autorité de la Conseillère de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) / Directrice de l'Institut français du Qatar (IFQ) et de l’Attachée de coopération pour le français (ACPF) / Directrice adjointe supervisant l’activité de l’Institut français au Qatar (IFQ), vous occupez les fonctions de secrétaire général (SG) d’un établissement à autonomie financière (EAF) en organisant le fonctionnement et la gestion administrative, matérielle, juridique, budgétaire et financière de l'IFQ. Le poste est également ouvert aux agents de catégorie A.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 Sous l’autorité de la COCAC et de l'ACPF, vous êtes responsable des affaires générales, des questions budgétaires, comptables et administratives, du management des ressources humaines, de la gestion immobilière, logistique, matérielle et de la sécurité. Vos missions principales sont les suivantes : 1\. Contribution au pilotage : \-présentation des résultats et performances ; \-réalisation d'études de rentabilité et analyses prospectives ; \-accompagne le directeur dans sa politique de mécénat et de sponsoring ; \-réflexion sur la trajectoire financière, la rationalisation des moyens et la diversification des ressources. 2\. Gestion financière et budgétaire : \-préparation et exécution du budget, élaboration des budgets rectificatifs, mise en place d’outils d’optimisation de gestion, analyse des comptes budgétaires et suivi des tableaux de bord ; \-interface avec le ministère (DGM/DDC/RES, tutelle de l'IF) pour le contrôle de gestion et le rapport d’activités ; \-suivi du Contrôle interne financier (CIF) avec l'Agence comptable régionale (ACR). Le SG est membre du comité de gouvernance. 3\. Gestion des ressources humaines : \-coordination et encadrement des personnels, suivi de l’organigramme fonctionnel (ADL, expatriés), plannings, congés ; \-gestion administrative des personnels (recrutement, déroulement de carrière, contrats, évaluation, ...), suivi, application de la législation locale du travail ; \-animation du dialogue social, relations avec les représentants du personnel et délégués syndicaux, gestion des conflits ; \-mise en place de formations ; \-suivi des questions d'hygiène, de sécurité et de conditions de travail. 4\. Gestion administrative : \-pilotage administratif et juridique (contrôle des conventions, veille juridique, gestion du contentieux, suivi des contrats et conventions signés par chaque antenne, supervision des procédures administratives, rédaction des notes de service, rappel des instructions, coordination des moyens et des ressources, conventions de prestation, contrat de location des locaux, rédaction de contrats avec les artistes, gestion et accueil des artistes en tournée, contact avec les fournisseurs) ; \-contrôle des activités de l'ensemble des services : réorganisation des procédures, limitation du risque de vol/fraude (en particulier au niveau du centre de langues, de l'espace Campus France, de la médiathèque) ; \-suivi de l'inventaire et de l'archivage. 5\. Gestion logistique, matérielle et immobilière : \-gestion du bâti et de l'investissement (travaux et commande) ; \-négociation et suivi des contrats de maintenance ; \-gestion des risques et veille à l'application des consignes de sécurité.
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Expérience confirmée en management ainsi qu'en suivi budgétaire/gestion des ressources humaines d’un établissement à autonomie financière. Expérience réussie dans un contexte culturel différent. La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures\-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**About BCG Platinion**
 BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time\-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading\-edge tech platforms, at scale.
   

  

**Practice Area**
 BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York\-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh\-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
   

  

 We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management \& financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy\-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high\-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
   

  

 You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
   

  

 Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
* Driving results in complex environments
* Solving business and technology problems
* Building strong client relationships
* Leading and developing teams

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment
* Arabic language proficiency — strongly preferred for both roles given client and regulatory engagement
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for pipeline management
* Familiarity with EcoVadis, MSCI ESG, S\&P Global, or other ESG ratings platforms
* Knowledge of social auditing principles (SMETA, SA8000\) as an additional CER service area


**What We Offer**
* Country\-embedded, client\-facing role with real delivery responsibility and direct market impact
* High visibility to MCA Sustainability Director and regional leadership from day one
* Exposure to sustainability mandates and clients across 35\+ countries within the MCA region
* Competitive salary benchmarked to local market (Egypt — Cairo / Qatar — Doha)
* Access to BV’s global CER methodology, tools, accreditations and technical expertise network
* Clear career pathway into senior specialist, area lead or technical expert roles within BV MCA Sustainability
* Professional development through BV’s internal training programmes and external sustainability certification support
